items.title: ServiceNow暴跌27%淪史上最大單日跌幅 財報再掀AI顛覆疑慮
items.title_en: ServiceNow Plummets 27%, Marking Its Largest One‑Day Drop in History as Earnings Revive AI Disruption Concerns
paras: 《CNBC》報導，ServiceNow (NOW-US) 股價週四(29日)重挫26.95%，為公司史上最大單日跌幅，這家企業軟體商的第三季財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對AI可能顛覆傳統軟體產業的擔憂。
花旗分析師 Tyler Radke 表示，「以 ServiceNow 的表現標準來看，這次有點不尋常，主要是財報超出預期的幅度不足。」
ServiceNow第三季營收年增逾20%，達41.1億美元，大致符合LSEG調查分析師預估的41億美元。調整後每股盈餘(EPS)則不如預期，為1美元，低於市場預估的1.02美元。
這份財報未能有效消除市場近期對「軟體即服務末日」(SaaSpocalypse)的擔憂，也就是市場憂慮新的AI能力可能顛覆傳統軟體商業模式。
即使 ServiceNow 小幅上調2026全年訂閱營收展望至157.8億至157.9億美元，股價仍大幅下跌。此外，AI業務新增合約價值的平均金額也大增65%。
Radke 表示，令投資人感到不安的因素之一，是公司投資新成立的「前線部署工程團隊」，卻尚未立即展現成效。這個團隊會進駐企業內部，協助客戶打造AI解決方案。
他指出，「這還需要再等一段時間，因此我認為市場希望能更早看到成果。要真正看到成長出現轉折，我想可能得等到明年。」
paras_en: CNBC reported that ServiceNow (NOW-US) shares tumbled 26.95% on Thursday (the 29th), marking the biggest single‑day decline in the company’s history after its third‑quarter earnings fell short of expectations, reigniting market worries that AI could upend the traditional software industry.
Citi analyst Tyler Radke said, "By ServiceNow’s own performance standards, this is a bit unusual, mainly because the earnings beat was not large enough."

ServiceNow’s third‑quarter revenue grew more than 20% year‑over‑year to $4.11 billion, roughly in line with LSEG analysts’ forecast of $4.1 billion. Adjusted earnings per share came in at $1.00, below the market expectation of $1.02.
The results failed to allay recent market concerns about a potential “SaaSpocalypse,” where new AI capabilities could disrupt traditional software business models.

Even though ServiceNow modestly raised its full‑year 2026 subscription revenue outlook to $15.78 billion‑$15.79 billion, the stock still fell sharply, while the average contract value of new AI business deals jumped 65%.

Radke noted that one unsettling factor for investors is the company’s investment in a newly created “front‑line deployment engineering team,” which has yet to show immediate results. This team will embed within enterprises to help customers build AI solutions.
He added, "That will take some more time, so I think the market wants to see results sooner. To really see a turning point in growth, I think we may have to wait until next year."

items.title: 美光下挫5%！記憶體股面臨「高標」考驗 三星財報亮眼仍難滿足市場
items.title_en: Micron Slides 5% as Memory Stocks Face a ‘High Bar’ Test; Samsung’s Strong Earnings Still Fall Short of Market Expectations
paras: 記憶體同業三星電子周四公布獲利連四季刷新紀錄，當天股價卻下挫4.1%，凸顯出市場對記憶體類股的要求有多高，美光(MU-US)這次也成了市場高期待下的受害者
美光周四股價下跌5%，收在每股934.27美元。
記憶體晶片業者創造龐大利潤，幾乎已成常態，三星也是如此。在晶片部門帶動下，三星上季淨利較去年同期暴增逾五倍，達75.136兆韓元(561.5億美元)，營業利益年增近八倍且突破100兆韓元整數門檻，營收也增為去年同期的兩倍以上。
但因為三星大致重申先前已公布的初步財報內容與股東回報計畫，並未帶來新的驚喜，似乎讓股東感到失望。這與南韓同業SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)形成對比，該公司周三公布財報時，宣布計劃向股東返還750億美元。
Counterpoint Research研究總監MS Hwang說：「三星公布財報後股價下跌，原因是股東回報計畫沒有帶來超出預期的驚喜。這凸顯在市場期待居高不下的情況下，投資人面臨的真正挑戰。」

美光下一關：大規模庫藏股計畫

美光接下來的考驗，是何時能啟動大規模股票回購。根據該公司2024年美國《晶片法案》(CHIPS Act)補助資金的相關條件，美光最快可於12月9日開始大規模實施庫藏股。
瑞銀(UBS)分析師Timothy Arcuri預估，美光每年回購股票的規模最高可達2,000億美元。
花旗分析師Atif Malik同樣看好美光，重申該股目標價為1,300美元。他周四說：「美光近期核准創紀錄的352億美元股票回購計畫，將有能力大幅提高股東回報。」
Malik說：「這項授權凸顯管理層對自由現金流能持續創造的信心，也反映出DRAM供需結構將持續趨緊，並延續至2027至2028年。」
paras_en: Memory‑chip peer Samsung Electronics reported record‑breaking profits for the fourth consecutive quarter on Thursday, yet its stock fell 4.1% that day, underscoring how lofty the market’s expectations are for memory stocks. Micron (MU‑US) became another victim of those high hopes.
Micron’s shares dropped 5% on Thursday, closing at $934.27 per share.

Profits in the memory‑chip business have become almost routine, and Samsung is no exception. Driven by its chip division, Samsung’s net profit for the latest quarter surged more than five‑fold year‑over‑year to 75.136 trillion won ($56.15 billion), operating profit jumped nearly eight‑fold to break the 100‑trillion‑won threshold, and revenue more than doubled versus the same period last year.

However, because Samsung essentially reiterated the preliminary earnings figures and shareholder‑return plan it had already disclosed, offering no fresh surprises, shareholders appeared disappointed. This contrasts with South Korean rival SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), which on Wednesday announced a plan to return $75 billion to shareholders when it released its earnings.

Counterpoint Research director MS Hwang said, “Samsung’s stock fell after the earnings release because the shareholder‑return plan didn’t exceed expectations. This highlights the real challenge investors face when market expectations remain sky‑high.”
Micron’s next hurdle: launching a large‑scale share‑repurchase program. Under the conditions of the company’s 2024 U.S. CHIPS Act funding, Micron could begin a major buyback as early as December 9.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri estimates Micron could repurchase up to $200 billion of its own stock each year.

Citigroup analyst Atif Malik also remains bullish on Micron, reaffirming a target price of $1,300. He said on Thursday, “Micron’s recently approved record‑setting $35.2 billion share‑repurchase plan will significantly boost shareholder returns.”
Malik added, “This authorization reflects management’s confidence in the continued generation of free cash flow and signals that the DRAM supply‑demand balance will stay tight through 2027‑2028.”

items.title: 日銀利率暫留1.25% 分析師估12月升至1.5% 終點上看2%
items.title_en: BOJ Keeps Rate at 1.25% – Analysts See 1.5% Rise in December, Target Around 2%
paras: 日本銀行 (日銀) 預計在周五 (30日) 結束的貨幣政策會議上維持基準利率於1.25%不變，但可能在最新季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的通膨預測，並強調日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。這將顯示日銀政策重心正從長期刺激通膨，轉向防止物價漲幅超標，為最快12月再次升息保留空間。
《路透社》報導指出，日銀此次預計不會連續兩次會議升息，而是希望進一步觀察先前升息對銀行放款條件與金融環境的影響。不過，日銀可能藉由政策聲明釋出更明確的訊號，表明未來將持續調升利率，逐步使利率接近不刺激、也不抑制經濟活動的中性水準。

這項政策轉向將延續日銀上月傳達的訊息。分析人士指出，日銀已進入較為重視抑制通膨風險的政策階段，未來可能每隔數個月升息一次。瑞穗研究所 (Mizuho Research Institute) 執行經濟學家、日銀前高層門間一夫表示，人工智慧 (AI) 投資帶來的全球價格壓力相當強勁，近期通膨有一部分是由需求增加所推動。他認為，日銀若確認政策方向已經轉變，等於向市場傳達可能每季升息的訊號，並預測日銀可能在12月及明年3月升息。
日銀總裁植田和男會後記者會的談話，也將成為市場觀察未來升息時點與幅度的重要依據。熟悉日銀想法的人士向《路透社》透露，日銀可能在季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的物價預測，並指出日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。隨著薪資成長逐漸穩定，企業與家庭的通膨預期也維持在約2%，日銀可能強調，接下來的政策任務是透過逐步升息，讓通膨穩定在目標附近。
日本通膨壓力仍是日銀考慮進一步緊縮政策的主要原因。9月核心消費者物價通膨率在睽違9個月後再次超過日銀2%的目標，中東衝突延長推升燃料成本，也削弱政府燃料補貼對物價的抑制效果。日銀7月公布的季度預測原本就預期，隨著企業持續將成本上升轉嫁給消費者，未來數月通膨可能加速。
日元走弱同樣加劇物價壓力。日元貶值推高進口商品成本，能源價格居高不下則進一步增加企業與家庭負擔。日銀今年6月升息後，9月再度調高利率，兩次升息間隔已短於2024年與2025年大約每年升息兩次的節奏，顯示政策正常化速度正在加快。
根據《路透社》對分析師的調查，多數受訪者預期日銀最快在12月將政策利率由1.25%提高至1.5%，之後明年仍會繼續升息。分析師對本輪升息周期終點利率的預估，主要落在1.75%至2%之間。若日銀明確表示基礎通膨已達到與2%目標一致的水準，市場可能將此解讀為央行不願容忍通膨進一步超標，未來升息步伐也可能更加靈活。
不過，日銀仍須在控制物價與維持經濟穩定之間取得平衡。若過早或過快升息，可能對企業融資、銀行放款及整體經濟活動造成影響；若通膨壓力持續擴大，則可能迫使央行加快緊縮步伐。因此，即使此次會議預計按兵不動，市場仍將密切觀察日銀是否調整通膨預測，以及植田和男對未來政策路徑的說明。
日銀政策轉向也與全球通膨環境相互呼應。AI產業投資熱潮推升部分商品與服務需求，中東衝突則造成能源供應與價格風險，美國與歐洲央行同樣面臨通膨壓力升高的挑戰。對日本而言，能源成本上升、日元偏弱與薪資成長逐步擴散，正共同影響物價走勢。
整體而言，日銀此次會議的關鍵不只在於是否維持1.25%的利率，更在於能否清楚傳達下一階段的政策方向。若日銀確認基礎通膨已接近目標，並上修未來物價預測，將進一步強化市場對12月升息的預期；但實際升息時間與後續幅度，仍取決於通膨、薪資、匯率及金融環境的變化。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1.25% at the monetary‑policy meeting ending on Friday (the 30th), but may slightly raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the latest quarterly outlook and stress that core inflation has basically reached the 2% target. This would show the BOJ’s focus shifting from long‑term stimulus to preventing price gains from overshooting, leaving room for a possible rate hike as early as December.

Reuters reported that the BOJ does not plan to raise rates at two consecutive meetings, preferring to watch how the previous hike affects banks’ lending conditions and the broader financial environment. However, the central bank may use its policy statement to send a clearer signal that it will keep tightening, gradually moving rates toward a neutral level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic activity.

This policy shift continues the message the BOJ delivered last month. Analysts say the bank has entered a phase that places greater emphasis on curbing inflation risks and may raise rates every few months. Mizuho Research Institute senior economist and former BOJ official Kazuo Kadokawa noted that AI‑driven investment is creating strong global price pressure and that recent inflation is partly demand‑driven. He believes that once the BOJ confirms the policy turn, it will signal to the market a possible quarterly hike and forecasts rate increases in December and March next year.

Comments by BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting will be a key reference for the market on the timing and magnitude of future hikes. Sources familiar with the BOJ told Reuters that the bank may modestly lift its price outlook for the next fiscal year in the quarterly outlook and point out that core inflation has essentially hit the 2% goal. With wage growth stabilising, firms and households expect inflation around 2%, and the BOJ may stress that its next task is to bring inflation close to target through gradual rate hikes.

Inflation pressure in Japan remains the main reason the BOJ is considering further tightening. Core CPI in September again exceeded the 2% target for the first time in nine months, while the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed fuel costs higher and weakened the effect of government fuel subsidies. The BOJ’s July quarterly forecast already anticipated that, as firms keep passing higher costs onto consumers, inflation could accelerate in the coming months.

A weaker yen also amplifies price pressure. Yen depreciation raises the cost of imported goods, and persistently high energy prices further increase the burden on firms and households. After the BOJ’s June hike, it raised rates again in September, with the interval between hikes now shorter than the roughly semi‑annual rhythm expected for 2024‑25, indicating an accelerating pace of policy normalisation.

A Reuters poll of analysts found most expect the BOJ to lift the policy rate from 1.25% to 1.5% as early as December, with further hikes likely next year. Analysts’ forecasts for the end‑point of this tightening cycle cluster around 1.75%‑2%. If the BOJ explicitly states that core inflation has reached the 2% target, markets may read that as a sign the central bank will not tolerate further overshoot, making future hikes potentially more flexible.

Nevertheless, the BOJ must balance price control with economic stability. Raising rates too early or too quickly could hurt corporate financing, bank lending and overall activity, while persistent inflation pressure could force a faster tightening. Hence, even if the meeting ends with a hold, markets will watch closely for any revision to inflation forecasts and Governor Ueda’s guidance on the policy path ahead.

The BOJ’s policy turn also mirrors the global inflation environment. AI‑driven investment is boosting demand for certain goods and services, the Middle‑East conflict is creating energy‑supply and price risks, and central banks in the US and Europe face similar inflation‑driving challenges. For Japan, rising energy costs, a soft yen and gradually expanding wages are jointly shaping price dynamics.

Overall, the key to this BOJ meeting is not only whether the 1.25% rate is maintained but also whether the bank can clearly convey its next‑stage policy direction. If the BOJ confirms core inflation is near target and upgrades its price outlook, it will reinforce market expectations of a December hike; however, the actual timing and size of any future moves will still depend on developments in inflation, wages, exchange rates and the financial environment.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉黃金挫逾1% PCE通膨加速升溫鞏固升息押注
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Gold Slides Over 1% as PCE Inflation Accelerates, Reinforcing Rate‑Hike Bets
paras: 黃金周四(29日)下挫逾1%，最新數據顯示美國通膨居高不下，強化聯準會(Fed)今年再度升息的預期心理，並打壓不孳息的黃金。

黃金現貨下跌1.4%，報每盎司4008.76美元。
美國12月黃金期貨收低0.5%，報每盎司4031.40美元。
在10月即將結束前，黃金正邁向連兩個月月線收黑。


High Ridge Futures金屬交易主管David Meger說：「通膨前景持續頑強居高不下，通膨率仍高於Fed目標，正讓市場開始認為，Fed可能在12月會議中升息。這是目前拖累黃金市場的主要因素，而今天公布的個人消費支出(PCE)報告，也絲毫未能緩解這項疑慮。」
美國9月通膨加速，美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)表示，9月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)月增0.5%，高於8月未經修正的月增0.3%，主因是消費者支付的汽油及其他商品價格上漲。
Fed周三一如預期維持利率不變，將借貸成本的調整延至下周美國期中選舉後。根據芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具，交易員目前押注12月升息的機率約為80%。
利率走高會增加持有不孳息黃金的機會成本。
Meger說：「市場下一個重要焦點，是持續關注能源市場。我們知道，能源價格是通膨疑慮的重要來源。因此，中東局勢無論升級或緩和，只要導致能源價格上漲或下跌，都可能對金屬價格產生重大影響。」
投資人也正關注11月3日的美國期中選舉，以及選舉結果可能對財政政策與整體市場情緒造成的影響。
歐洲央行(ECB)周四表示，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)將於2月7日卸任。歐洲央行同日維持利率不變，但警告能源成本飆升正使通膨風險升高。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌3.5%，報每盎司52.08美元。
現貨白金下跌3.7%，報每盎司1481.50美元。
現貨鈀金下跌0.9%，報每盎司1001.92美元。
三種貴金屬10月月線也都邁向連續第二個月收黑。
paras_en: Gold fell more than 1% on Thursday (the 29th), with the latest data showing U.S. inflation remaining high, bolstering expectations that the Federal Reserve may raise rates again this year and weighing on non‑yielding gold.

Spot gold dropped 1.4% to $4,008.76 per ounce. U.S. December gold futures fell 0.5% to $4,031.40 per ounce. As October draws to a close, gold is heading for a second consecutive month of negative monthly closes.

U.S. September inflation accelerated, the Bureau of Economic Analysis said the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, up from an unadjusted 0.3% gain in August, driven mainly by higher gasoline and other commodity prices paid by consumers.

The Fed kept rates unchanged on Wednesday as expected, postponing any borrowing‑cost adjustments until after the U.S. midterm elections next week. According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, traders are now betting roughly an 80% chance of a rate hike in December.
Higher interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non‑yielding gold.

Meger added that the market’s next key focus is the energy market. Energy prices are a major source of inflation concerns, so any escalation or de‑escalation in the Middle East that moves energy prices up or down could have a significant impact on metal prices.
Investors are also watching the U.S. midterm elections on November 3 and how the results might affect fiscal policy and overall market sentiment.

The European Central Bank said on Thursday that President Christine Lagarde will step down on February 7. The ECB kept rates unchanged on the same day but warned that soaring energy costs are raising inflation risks.

Other precious metals: Spot silver fell 3.5% to $52.08 per ounce. Spot platinum dropped 3.7% to $1,481.50 per ounce. Spot palladium slipped 0.9% to $1,001.92 per ounce. All three metals are also moving toward a second consecutive month of negative October closes.

items.title: 〈財報〉亞馬遜Q3營收、獲利均遜色 自由現金流流出424億美元 盤後一度挫逾7%
items.title_en: Amazon Q3 Revenue and Profit Miss Expectations, Free Cash Flow Outflow $42.4 B, After-Hours Stock Fell Over 7%
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 第三季財報表現不如華爾街預期，且人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資持續消耗現金，加上第四季假期購物旺季營收展望未能帶來明顯驚喜，股價周四 (29日) 盤後一度下跌逾7%。儘管亞馬遜雲端服務 (AWS) 營收年增近四成，成為本季主要亮點，但零售與廣告業務表現疲弱，加上公司維持全年2,200億美元資本支出計畫，市場仍關注巨額AI投資何時能轉化為更強勁的現金流與財務回報。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團 (LSEG) 彙整的分析師預估，亞馬遜第三季每股盈餘為1.89美元，低於市場預期的1.96美元；營收為2,019.4億美元，也略低於預估的2,023.1億美元。不過，營收仍較去年同期的1,801.7億美元成長12%；若排除匯率變動造成的約9億美元不利影響，營收年增率為13%。

亞馬遜第三季主要財報數據如下：



亞馬遜第三季淨利為206.9億美元，低於去年同期的211.9億美元；稀釋後每股盈餘則由去年同期的1.95美元降至1.89美元。公司指出，淨利下滑主要與去年第三季認列投資AI新創公司Anthropic帶來的95億美元稅前收益有關，這筆收益屬於非營業項目，墊高了去年同期的比較基期。
不過，亞馬遜第三季營業利益升至280.8億美元，較去年同期的174.2億美元大幅增加，營業利益率達13.9%，創公司歷史新高。北美業務營收年增6%至1,129億美元，營業利益由去年同期的48億美元增至87億美元；國際業務營收年增5%至431億美元，營業利益由12億美元增至16億美元。AWS營業利益則由去年同期的114億美元升至177.7億美元，顯示雲端業務不僅營收成長，也持續貢獻獲利。
AWS第三季營收年增39.3%至459.8億美元，高於市場預估的452.9億美元，成長速度為近五年來最快，並形成約1,840億美元的年化營收規模。執行長賈西 (Andy Jassy) 在財報聲明中表示，公司在AWS功能與基礎設施上的投資正逐漸發揮效果，並預期AWS在2027年與2028年的營收成長率都將超過40%。
面對投資人對AI支出效益的關注，亞馬遜也強調自家AI服務與晶片業務的進展。公司表示，Bedrock AI模型平台的市場需求持續增加，Trainium AI晶片與Graviton處理器業務也逐步擴大。賈西指出，亞馬遜晶片業務持續維持三位數的年增幅，並計畫在2027年底讓Trainium晶片對外部客戶開放使用，為先前提出的對外供應方向進一步設定時間表。
然而，AI基礎設施投資的資金需求也對自由現金流構成沉重壓力。亞馬遜連續第二季出現負自由現金流，截至9月底的過去12個月，自由現金流流出423.6億美元，較去年同期流入147.9億美元明顯惡化。上一季的過去12個月自由現金流流出為76億美元，代表資金消耗情況進一步擴大。
公司指出，自由現金流惡化主要是因為購置不動產與設備的支出增加，背後原因以AI相關投資為主。過去12個月，亞馬遜購置不動產與設備的淨支出年增948億美元；《路透社》報導亦指出，第三季相關資本支出達772.6億美元，約比市場預期高出200億美元。雖然同期過去12個月營業現金流年增29%至1,683億美元，但龐大的設備投資仍使自由現金流轉為大幅流出。
亞馬遜並未因此下修全年資本支出預測，仍預期2026年現金資本支出約達2,200億美元。賈西在與投資人的電話會議中更表示，公司預期2027年支出將「大幅高於」2026年，但同時強調，亞馬遜已能清楚看見這些投資帶來具吸引力財務回報的路徑。這番說法凸顯公司仍打算積極擴建AI運算與雲端基礎設施，而不是因短期現金流壓力大幅放慢投資。
其他大型科技公司近期也開始受到市場檢視。微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US) 本周將年度資本支出預測由1,750億美元下調至1,700億美元；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 則維持全年資本支出1,950億至2,050億美元的預測。相較之下，亞馬遜不僅維持2,200億美元的全年支出目標，執行長還預告明年將進一步增加投資，使市場更關注AI基礎設施建設的回報速度與現金流壓力。
亞馬遜零售與廣告業務的表現則相對疲弱。第三季線上商店營收年增2%至684.7億美元，低於市場預估的696.8億美元；廣告營收為196.4億美元，也低於市場預估的208.2億美元。依市場數據，廣告營收較去年同期下滑11%，但這項比較受到Prime Day促銷檔期調整影響。
亞馬遜今年將部分國家的年度Prime Day促銷活動從往年第三季提前至第二季，以避開7月舉行的國際足總世界盃 (FIFA World Cup) 賽事。去年Prime Day則完全落在第三季，因此促銷檔期改變影響本季線上零售與廣告收入的年增比較。亞馬遜表示，若排除匯率影響，第三季廣告營收年增12%，並預期第四季廣告營收成長率將回升至高十位數百分比。
展望第四季，亞馬遜預估營收將介於2,400億至2,470億美元，年增12%至16%，區間中值為2,435億美元，低於LSEG彙整的市場預估約2,445億美元。公司預期匯率變動將對第四季營收成長造成約60個基點的不利影響；營業利益則預估介於285億至335億美元，高於去年同期的250億美元。
第四季通常是亞馬遜全年營收最重要的季度之一，主要受年終假期購物旺季帶動。儘管公司預期營收仍將維持雙位數成長，市場仍將觀察消費者在燃料與生活成本偏高的環境下是否持續支出，以及亞馬遜能否藉由更快配送、擴大偏遠地區服務與改善零售利潤率，持續爭取電商市占率。
整體而言，亞馬遜第三季呈現兩種不同走勢：AWS以近五年最快的速度成長，營業利益與公司整體營業利益率也創下佳績；但線上零售與廣告業務未達市場預期，AI投資則讓自由現金流大幅轉負。公司維持2026年2,200億美元資本支出預測，並預告2027年投資還將增加，意味著接下來市場評價亞馬遜的關鍵，將不只在於AI與雲端業務能成長多快，也在於這些投入能否持續帶來足夠的營收、獲利與現金回報。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) reported third‑quarter results that fell short of Wall Street forecasts, and its AI infrastructure spending continued to drain cash. Combined with a lackluster holiday‑season revenue outlook for Q4, the stock slipped more than 7% in after‑hours trading on Thursday (the 29th). Although AWS revenue grew nearly 40% year‑over‑year, making it the quarter’s bright spot, weak retail and advertising performance and a full‑year capital‑expenditure plan of $220 billion kept investors focused on when massive AI investments will translate into stronger cash flow and financial returns.

According to analyst estimates compiled by LSEG, Amazon’s Q3 earnings per share were $1.89, below the consensus of $1.96; revenue came in at $201.94 billion, slightly under the $202.31 billion forecast. Nonetheless, revenue was up 12% from $180.17 billion a year earlier, and when the roughly $0.9 billion adverse currency impact is stripped out, the year‑over‑year growth rate is 13%.

Amazon’s Q3 key figures show net income of $20.69 billion, down from $21.19 billion a year ago, and diluted EPS fell from $1.95 to $1.89. The company said the profit decline mainly reflects a $9.5 billion pre‑tax gain from last year’s investment in AI startup Anthropic, which was a non‑operating item that inflated the prior‑year baseline.

Operating income, however, rose to $28.08 billion, up sharply from $17.42 billion a year earlier, delivering an operating margin of 13.9% – a company record. North America revenue grew 6% to $112.9 billion, with operating profit climbing from $4.8 billion to $8.7 billion. International revenue rose 5% to $43.1 billion, with operating profit increasing from $1.2 billion to $1.6 billion. AWS operating profit jumped from $11.4 billion to $17.77 billion, showing the cloud business is not only growing revenue but also contributing profit.

AWS Q3 revenue grew 39.3% year‑over‑year to $45.98 billion, beating the $45.29 billion consensus and marking the fastest growth in nearly five years, creating an annualized revenue run‑rate of about $184 billion. CEO Andy Jassy said AWS investments in features and infrastructure are beginning to pay off and expects AWS revenue growth rates to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028.

Addressing investor concerns about AI spending returns, Amazon highlighted progress in its AI services and chip businesses. Demand for the Bedrock AI model platform continues to rise, and the Trainium AI chip and Graviton processor lines are expanding. Jassy noted that Amazon’s chip segment is maintaining triple‑digit annual growth and plans to open Trainium to external customers by the end of 2027, setting a timetable for the previously announced external‑supply strategy.

AI infrastructure spending, however, has put heavy pressure on free cash flow. Amazon recorded a second consecutive quarter of negative free cash flow, with a 12‑month outflow of $42.36 billion as of the end of September, a sharp deterioration from the $14.79 billion inflow in the same period a year earlier. The prior quarter’s 12‑month outflow was $7.6 billion, indicating an accelerating cash drain.

The company said the free‑cash‑flow decline stems mainly from higher capital expenditures on property and equipment, driven largely by AI‑related investments. Over the past 12 months, net spending on property and equipment rose $94.8 billion year‑over‑year; Reuters reported Q3 capital spending of $77.26 billion, about $20 billion above market expectations. Although operating cash flow for the same 12‑month window grew 29% to $168.3 billion, the massive equipment outlays turned free cash flow into a large outflow.

Amazon has not cut its full‑year cap‑ex forecast, still expecting roughly $220 billion of cash capital spending in 2026. Jassy told investors that 2027 spending will be “significantly higher” than 2026, while emphasizing that the company can already see a clear path to attractive financial returns from these investments. This underscores Amazon’s intent to keep expanding AI compute and cloud infrastructure rather than slowing down due to short‑term cash‑flow pressure.

Other big‑tech peers are also under market scrutiny. Microsoft (MSFT-US) trimmed its annual cap‑ex outlook this week from $175 billion to $170 billion, while Alphabet (GOOGL-US) kept its full‑year cap‑ex guidance in the $195‑$205 billion range. By contrast, Amazon maintains a $220 billion annual spend target and its CEO signaled further increases next year, drawing attention to the speed and cash‑flow impact of AI infrastructure returns.

Amazon’s retail and advertising segments lagged. Q3 online store revenue grew 2% year‑over‑year to $68.47 billion, missing the $69.68 billion estimate, while ad revenue was $19.64 billion, also below the $20.82 billion forecast. Advertising revenue fell 11% versus a year ago, a dip partly affected by the timing shift of Prime Day promotions.

Amazon moved some countries’ annual Prime Day events from the usual Q3 slot to Q2 this year to avoid the July FIFA World Cup. Last year Prime Day fell entirely in Q3, so the shift altered the year‑over‑year comparison for online retail and ad revenue. Amazon said that, excluding currency effects, Q3 ad revenue grew 12% year‑over‑year and it expects Q4 ad growth to rebound to high‑double‑digit percentages.

Looking ahead to Q4, Amazon projects revenue between $240 billion and $247 billion, a 12%‑16% increase year‑over‑year, with a midpoint of $243.5 billion, slightly below LSEG’s consensus of about $244.5 billion. The company expects currency movements to shave roughly 60 basis points off Q4 revenue growth, and operating profit is forecast at $28.5 billion to $33.5 billion, above last year’s $25 billion.

Q4 is traditionally one of Amazon’s most important quarters, driven by the holiday shopping season. While the company expects double‑digit revenue growth, the market will watch whether consumers continue to spend amid higher fuel and living‑cost pressures, and whether Amazon can capture more e‑commerce share through faster delivery, expanded remote‑area services, and improved retail margins.

Overall, Amazon’s Q3 showed two divergent trends: AWS grew at its fastest pace in five years, delivering record operating profit and boosting the company‑wide margin, while online retail and advertising fell short of expectations and AI spending turned free cash flow sharply negative. The firm kept its 2026 $220 billion cap‑ex forecast and signaled higher 2027 investment, meaning the market’s assessment of Amazon will hinge not only on the speed of AI and cloud growth but also on whether those investments generate sufficient revenue, profit and cash returns.

items.title: SanDisk Q1營收年增378% 宣布1拆8股票分割
items.title_en: SanDisk Q1 Revenue Up 378% YoY Announces 1-for-8 Stock Split
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，重新成為獨立公司不到兩年，SanDisk(SNDK-US)計劃進行股票分割。
根據道瓊市場數據，自 2025 年 2 月與威騰電子(Western Digital)(WDC-US)分拆以來，SanDisk 股價已上漲逾 2,600%。該公司已成為標普 500 指數中股價最高成分股之一，週四(29日)收盤報 1,330 美元。截至當日，指數中只有五家公司的股價高於 SanDisk。
單看股價高低本身並沒有太大意義，尤其在投資人可以輕易買賣零股的時代。不過，股票分割會增加流通股數，並相應降低每股價格。企業通常表示，此舉能讓更多投資人更容易買進自家股票。
SanDisk 也不例外。該公司宣布將進行 1 拆 8 的股票分割，預計 11 月 19 日生效。公司指出，股價降低後，也有助於員工透過相關計畫購買公司股票。
股票分割不會改變公司整體價值，也不會改變各投資人持有的公司價值。至於股票分割是否真能讓股票更受散戶投資人青睞，相關研究的結論並不一致。不過，有些專家指出，股價降低具有一定的心理優勢，因為較低的價格看起來不會那麼令人卻步。
SanDisk 在公布財報時同步宣布股票分割計畫。公司預估，截至12月一季(2027會計年度第二季)營收將達 122 億至 126 億美元。FactSet 追蹤的分析師原先預估營收為 123 億美元。
SanDisk截至9月一季(Q1)營收達 110 億美元，較去年同期成長 378%，高於分析師預估的 107 億美元。
執行長 David Goeckeler 強調，公司產品「需求強勁且持續成長」，帶動「資料中心業務的成長速度超越其他業務」。
截至發稿，SanDisk股價週四盤後在震盪交易中下跌逾3%。
SanDisk 是人工智慧熱潮主要受惠者之一。AI 熱潮帶動儲存及傳輸資料相關產品的需求前所未有。由於旗下儲存產品供應吃緊，公司得以大幅調漲價格，並實現相當可觀的獲利成長。
在此背景下，SanDisk第一季調整後毛利率達 85.1%，代表公司在扣除產品製造成本後，能保留的營收比重。這項數據高於 截至6月一季的 84.6% 調整後毛利率。
SanDisk 預估，第二季調整後毛利率將介於 84.5% 至 85.5% 之間。
第一季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)暴增 6,913%，達 52.60 美元，高於市場預期的 46.67 美元。但公司也提醒，這項百分比「並不具實質意義」。
SanDisk 今年以來一直是標普 500 指數中表現最佳股票之一，2026 年迄今股價已上漲逾 450%，漲幅僅次於莫德納(Moderna)。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that less than two years after becoming an independent company again, SanDisk (SNDK-US) is planning a stock split.

According to Dow Jones market data, since the spin‑off from Western Digital (WDC-US) in February 2025, SanDisk’s share price has risen more than 2,600%. The company has become one of the highest‑priced constituents of the S&P 500, closing Thursday (the 29th) at $1,330. As of that day, only five companies in the index traded above SanDisk’s price.

Looking at the absolute price alone isn’t very meaningful, especially in an era where investors can easily trade fractional shares. However, a stock split increases the number of shares outstanding and correspondingly lowers the price per share. Companies usually say the move makes it easier for more investors to buy their stock.

SanDisk is no exception. The company announced a 1‑for‑8 stock split, expected to take effect on November 19. It noted that a lower share price also helps employees purchase company stock through related plans.

A stock split does not change the company’s overall value nor the value each investor holds. Whether a split truly makes a stock more attractive to retail investors is debated in research. Some experts point out that a lower price has a psychological advantage because it looks less intimidating.

SanDisk disclosed the split plan alongside its earnings release. The company projects Q2 of its 2027 fiscal year (the December quarter) revenue of $12.2 billion to $12.6 billion. FactSet‑tracked analysts had originally forecast $12.3 billion.
For the quarter ending September (Q1), SanDisk reported revenue of $11.0 billion, up 378% year‑over‑year and above analysts’ estimate of $10.7 billion.
Chief Executive David Goeckeler emphasized that the company’s products are experiencing "strong and sustained demand," driving data‑center business growth at a faster pace than other segments.
At the time of writing, SanDisk’s share price was down more than 3% in after‑hours trading on Thursday.

SanDisk is one of the primary beneficiaries of the AI boom. The surge in AI has created unprecedented demand for storage and data‑transfer products. Tight supply of its storage offerings has allowed the company to raise prices sharply and achieve substantial profit growth.

In this context, SanDisk’s adjusted gross margin for Q1 reached 85.1%, indicating the proportion of revenue retained after product‑manufacturing costs. This is higher than the 84.6% adjusted gross margin recorded for the quarter ending June.
SanDisk forecasts its adjusted gross margin for Q2 to be between 84.5% and 85.5%.
Adjusted earnings per share surged 6,913% in Q1 to $52.60, beating market expectations of $46.67, though the company cautioned that the percentage figure "has no substantive meaning."
Since the start of the year, SanDisk has been one of the best‑performing stocks in the S&P 500, with its price up more than 450% in 2026, second only to Moderna.

items.title: Alphabet暴跌觸發「死亡交叉」！最慘跌勢過了嗎？歷史數據曝轉機
items.title_en: Alphabet Plummets Triggering a "Death Cross"! Is the Worst Decline Over? Historical Data Suggests a Turning Point
paras: Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 第三季財報不如預期，核心搜尋業務成長放緩，拖累股價週四 (29 日) 暴跌逾 12%，並觸發技術面偏空的「死亡交叉」。不過，歷史數據顯示，Alphabet 過去十年出現這項訊號後，多數情況下半年後股價反而走高；另一項動能指標也降至逾 15 年低點，為這波跌勢是否接近尾聲留下想像空間。
《MarketWatch》報導，投資人近幾個月持續質疑 Alphabet 的人工智慧 (AI) 策略，股價早已呈現下行趨勢，最新財報失利則進一步加重賣壓。Alphabet 週四 (29 日) 暴跌逾 12%，創史上最大單日跌幅，市值蒸發5,000億美元，自 10 月初以來已下蝶超 16%。
根據 FactSet 數據，Alphabet 的 50 日簡單移動平均線週四降至 340.26 美元，跌破位於 340.93 美元的 200 日均線，形成俗稱的「死亡交叉」。此前，截至週三，其 50 日均線已連續 319 個交易日維持在 200 日均線之上。
死亡交叉代表近期平均股價跌至較長期間的平均水準之下，反映短期走勢已明顯弱於過去大部分時間的表現，通常被視為長期趨勢轉弱的訊號。
但這項訊號並不等同股價接下來必然續跌。
由於移動平均線是依據歷史收盤價計算，具有落後性，交叉出現時，股價往往已經歷一段跌勢。它較能確認跌勢持續的時間與幅度，未必能精準判斷進出場時點。
Alphabet 過往的表現也顯示，死亡交叉與後續走勢之間，並沒有單一答案。
根據道瓊市場數據，該股過去十年曾出現五次死亡交叉，其中四次在六個月後走高，五次的六個月平均漲幅為 21.9%。
最近一次發生於 2025 年 4 月 8 日。當時 Alphabet 在短短兩個月內，已自先前的歷史收盤高點下跌 29.9%，死亡交叉出現當天，恰好也是那波賣壓觸底之日。
然而，2022 年的經驗則呈現不同結果。當年 3 月 9 日出現死亡交叉時，Alphabet 股價已較四個月前的歷史高點下跌 11%，之後卻再跌 37.5%，直到同年 11 月 3 日、約八個月後才落底。這也說明，即使交叉形成前已有明顯跌幅，後續仍可能存在相當大的下行空間。
除了均線變化，Alphabet 的相對強弱指標 (RSI) 也顯示賣壓已相當集中。
其 14 日 RSI 降至 23.1，為 2011 年 6 月以來最低水準。
RSI 用於衡量價格變動的速度與幅度，交易員通常將 30 以下視為進入超賣區，反映股票短期內承受強烈賣壓。
Alphabet 目前的讀值遠低於這道門檻，意味近期跌勢已相當急促，也使市場開始關注是否可能出現反彈。
不過，超賣本身並不能確認股價已經落底。Alphabet 目前同時面臨財報失利、搜尋業務成長放緩與 AI 策略疑慮；歷史上的反彈紀錄與偏低的 RSI，提供的是賣壓可能接近極端的線索，能否轉化為持續回升，仍有待後續走勢驗證。
paras_en: Google parent company Alphabet (GOOGL-US) posted a third‑quarter earnings report that fell short of expectations, with its core search business slowing, sending the stock tumbling over 12% on Thursday (the 29th) and triggering a bearish technical "death cross". However, historical data shows that in most cases over the past decade, after this signal appears, the stock actually climbs higher six months later; another momentum indicator has also dropped to a more than 15‑year low, leaving room for speculation that the decline may be nearing its end.

MarketWatch reported that investors have been questioning Alphabet’s artificial intelligence (AI) strategy for months, and the stock has already been on a downtrend, with the latest earnings miss further intensifying selling pressure. Alphabet slumped more than 12% on Thursday (the 29th), marking its biggest single‑day drop in history, wiping out $500 billion in market value and falling more than 16% since early October.

According to FactSet data, Alphabet’s 50‑day simple moving average fell to $340.26 on Thursday, slipping below the 200‑day moving average at $340.93 and creating the so‑called "death cross." Prior to that, as of Wednesday, its 50‑day average had stayed above the 200‑day line for 319 consecutive trading days.

A death cross means the short‑term average price has fallen below the longer‑term average, indicating that recent momentum is clearly weaker than most of the past, and it is usually taken as a signal of a weakening long‑term trend.
But this signal does not mean the stock must continue to fall.

Because moving averages are calculated from historical closing prices, they are lagging; when a cross occurs, the price has often already undergone a decline. The cross is better at confirming how long and how far a downtrend may last, not at pinpointing precise entry or exit points.
Alphabet’s past performance also shows that there is no single answer linking a death cross to subsequent price action.

Based on Dow Jones market data, the stock has experienced five death crosses in the past ten years, and in four of those cases the price rose again after six months, with an average six‑month gain of 21.9% across the five instances.

The most recent occurrence was on April 8, 2025. At that time Alphabet had already fallen 29.9% from a prior historical closing high within just two months, and the day the death cross appeared coincided with the bottom of that selling pressure.

However, the 2022 experience yielded a different outcome. When a death cross formed on March 9, 2022, the stock was already 11% below its historical high from four months earlier, and it fell another 37.5% afterward, not bottoming out until November 3 of the same year, about eight months later. This shows that even after a sizable prior decline, substantial downside can still follow.
In addition to the moving‑average shift, Alphabet’s relative strength index (RSI) also indicates that selling pressure has become heavily concentrated.
Its 14‑day RSI dropped to 23.1, the lowest level since June 2011.
The RSI measures the speed and magnitude of price changes, and traders typically view readings below 30 as entering oversold territory, reflecting strong short‑term selling pressure.
Alphabet’s current reading is well below that threshold, suggesting the recent decline has been quite rapid and prompting the market to wonder whether a rebound may be imminent.

However, oversold conditions alone do not confirm that the stock has bottomed. Alphabet is simultaneously dealing with a disappointing earnings report, slowing search‑business growth and AI‑strategy concerns; historical rebound patterns and a low RSI merely hint that selling pressure may be reaching an extreme, and whether that will translate into a sustained recovery remains to be seen.

items.title: 〈財報〉英特爾財測疲弱暴跌20% 歸咎PC市場放緩
items.title_en: <Earnings> Intel’s Weak Outlook Triggers 20% Drop, Blames Slowing PC Market
paras: 晶片大廠英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)週四(29日)盤後公布2026會計年度第三季財報，營收僅略高於預期，且第四季財測疲弱，並指出全球PC市場持續低迷，導致盤後股價大跌20%。
英特爾在新聞稿中表示，第三季營收較去年同期的137億美元成長21%。

Q3 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：165.1 億美元 v.s. 165 億美元
調整後EPS：52 美分 v.s. 40 美分


然而，英特爾的客戶端運算與實體AI部門營收降至81億美元，較去年同期下滑5%，不如市場預期，即使資料中心與AI營收大增78%，達73億美元。
根據Counterpoint Research，受到記憶體及其他零組件成本飆升影響，全球PC出貨量第二季較去年同期下滑4%。
展望本季(Q4)，英特爾預估調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為25美分，營收介於150億至160億美元。數字低於LSEG分析師預期的營收171億美元及每股盈餘43美分。

FY 2026 Q4 財測 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：150-160 億美元 v.s. 171 億美元
EPS：25 美分 v.s. 43 美分


英特爾財務長David Zinsner在新聞稿中表示，「我們預期PC市場放緩的情況至少會持續到明年上半年，但對公司更廣泛產品組合所帶來的商機依然樂觀。我們將持續有紀律地投資產能與營運資金，以增加供應並支援未來成長。」
英特爾的財測也反映了本月稍早以色列一座晶圓廠發生爆炸事故的影響，該事故造成兩名工人死亡，另有一人重傷。Zinsner告訴《路透社》，這起事故預計將使公司在兩個季內損失約6億美元營收。他並表示，公司計劃在本週末前開始逐步提高該廠的產量。
英特爾股價今年以來大幅上漲，年初至今漲幅約150%，但隨著市場對AI基礎設施擴建規模的疑慮浮現，10月以來已下跌約23%。
Zinsner在電話會議上表示，「我們將持續以審慎的態度進行投資。除非我們對產品和製程技術的成熟度有信心，且有明確證據顯示客戶需求存在，否則我們不會投入任何一美元的資本支出。」
英特爾以業界領先的中央處理器（CPU）聞名，也成為代理式AI興起的受益者。聊天機器人與大型模型高度仰賴輝達(NVDA-US)及超微(AMD-US)的圖形處理器（GPU），但Meta (META-US)的Muse與OpenAI的Dots等代理式AI應用，則仰賴CPU協助協調雲端電腦系統中的任務與資料。
執行長陳立武在新聞稿中表示，「儘管PC產業整體近期面臨逆風，我們仍看到CPU需求強勁，長期而言，公司所有運算平台的需求也都相當穩健。」
同時，英特爾的晶圓代工業務仍苦於尋找穩定的發展方向。英特爾是唯一一家總部位於美國、能夠製造先進邏輯晶片的業者，目前已在亞利桑那州的新晶圓廠大量生產最先進的18A製程晶片，提供台積電(TSM-US)以外另一替代選項。
儘管目前英特爾仍是這項製程晶片的唯一主要客戶，但分析師表示，大型無晶圓廠晶片客戶可能在下一代14A製程晶片上選擇英特爾。
TechInsights分析師Dan Hutcheson表示，「業者希望有第二個供應來源，藉此向台積電施壓，讓台積電在定價上有所節制。所有大型業者都已在那裡進行測試。」
除了記憶體短缺外，另一項晶片製造的關鍵零組件「載板」（substrates）也面臨嚴重供應限制。Zinsner今年8月表示，載板供應「確實非常吃緊」。
川普政府去年取得英特爾10%股權。此前，英特爾在7奈米與10奈米製程技術上已落後競爭對手。輝達與日本軟銀（SoftBank）去年也對英特爾投資數十億美元。
相較於前任執行長季辛格(Pat Gelsinger)積極推動晶圓代工業務復興的雄心計畫，陳立武對晶圓代工支出的態度更為審慎。
英特爾上週表示，工程團隊已在俄亥俄州大型晶圓廠安裝第一根桁架。該廠原本預計2025年開始交付晶片。英特爾在亞利桑那州的下一座晶圓廠則預計於2028年底開始營運。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)本週也宣布擴大與英特爾的合作。在年度AI大會上，甲骨文表示，將部署英特爾下一代Xeon伺服器處理器，以及輝達和超微最新的機櫃級系統，持續擴充資料中心容量。
英特爾於8月完成一筆規模達230億美元的股票發行。近年來，科技巨頭為滿足市場對AI及相關基礎設施永無止境的需求，已投入數兆美元。

paras_en: Chip giant Intel (INTC-US) posted its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter results after market close on Thursday (the 29th). Revenue was only slightly above expectations and the fourth‑quarter outlook was weak, with the company citing a persistently sluggish global PC market, sending the after‑hours stock down about 20%.
Intel said in a press release that third‑quarter revenue grew 21% year‑over‑year to $13.7 billion.

Q3 key figures vs. LSEG estimates: Revenue: $16.51 billion vs. $16.5 billion; Adjusted EPS: 52 cents vs. 40 cents. However, revenue from client computing and physical AI fell to $8.1 billion, down 5% from a year ago and missing forecasts, even as data‑center and AI revenue jumped 78% to $7.3 billion.
According to Counterpoint Research, soaring memory and other component costs pushed global PC shipments down 4% in the second quarter versus a year earlier.

Looking ahead to the current quarter (Q4), Intel forecasts adjusted EPS of 25 cents and revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, both below LSEG analysts’ expectations of $17.1 billion in revenue and 43 cents EPS.

FY 2026 Q4 outlook vs. LSEG estimates: Revenue: $15‑$16 billion vs. $17.1 billion; EPS: 25 cents vs. 43 cents. CFO David Zinsner said in the release, “We expect the PC market slowdown to last at least into the first half of next year, but we remain optimistic about the opportunities a broader product portfolio brings. We will continue to invest disciplined capacity and working‑capital to increase supply and support future growth.”

Intel’s outlook also reflects the impact of an explosion at an Israeli fab earlier this month that killed two workers and injured another. Zinsner told Reuters the incident is expected to cost the company about $600 million in revenue over two quarters, and the company plans to start ramping up output at the plant by the end of the week.
Intel’s shares have surged roughly 150% year‑to‑date, but as doubts about the scale of AI infrastructure expansion have emerged, the stock has fallen about 23% since October.

Zinsner said on the earnings call, “We will continue to invest prudently. We will not spend a single dollar of capex unless we are confident in the maturity of our products and processes and have clear evidence of customer demand.”

Intel is known for its industry‑leading central processing units (CPUs) and has become a beneficiary of the rise of so‑called “agent AI.” Chatbots and large models rely heavily on NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and AMD (AMD-US) graphics processing units (GPUs), but agent‑AI applications such as Meta’s (META-US) Muse and OpenAI’s Dots depend on CPUs to coordinate tasks and data across cloud systems.
CEO Pat Gelsinger said in the release, “Even though the PC industry faces headwinds, we still see strong CPU demand, and over the long term demand across all of our compute platforms remains robust.”

At the same time, Intel’s foundry business continues to struggle to find a stable growth path. Intel is the only U.S.–based company that can manufacture advanced logic chips, and it is now mass‑producing its most advanced 18A‑process wafers at a new fab in Arizona, offering an alternative to TSMC (TSM-US).
Although Intel is currently the sole major customer for that process, analysts say large fab‑less chip makers may choose Intel for the next‑generation 14A process chips.
TechInsights analyst Dan Hutcheson said, “Customers want a second source to put pressure on TSMC and keep its pricing in check. All the big players are already testing there.”
Beyond memory shortages, another critical chip‑making component—substrates—faces severe supply constraints. Zinsner said in August that substrate supply “is indeed extremely tight.”

The Trump administration acquired a 10% stake in Intel last year. Previously, Intel had fallen behind rivals in 7‑nm and 10‑nm process technologies. NVIDIA and Japan’s SoftBank also invested billions of dollars in Intel last year.
Compared with former CEO Pat Gelsinger’s ambitious push to revive the foundry business, Pat Gelsinger’s successor takes a more cautious stance on foundry spending.

Intel said last week its engineering team installed the first truss in its large Ohio fab, which was originally slated to start shipping chips in 2025. Intel’s next Arizona fab is expected to begin operations by the end of 2028.

Oracle (ORCL-US) announced this week an expanded partnership with Intel. At its annual AI conference, Oracle said it will deploy Intel’s next‑generation Xeon server processors along with the latest rack‑scale systems from NVIDIA and AMD to continue expanding data‑center capacity.
Intel completed a $23 billion stock offering in August. In recent years, tech giants have poured trillions of dollars into meeting the seemingly endless demand for AI and related infrastructure.
All figures are updated as of the deadline.

paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 29th. Chairman Zheng Ping said that fourth‑quarter revenue will definitely be higher than the third quarter and the gross margin will not be worse than in Q3, although some intangible‑asset items still need to be reviewed at year‑end. Looking ahead to next year, as demand for AI data‑center construction continues, the company expects overall operations to remain on a growth trajectory, with AI and data‑center related businesses continuing to be the main growth drivers. Regarding global capacity layout, Delta’s board has approved the establishment of a large production site in Penang, Malaysia.

Yageo (2327‑TW), a major passive‑component manufacturer, held its earnings briefing on the 29th. General Manager and CEO Wang Dan‑ru said that the fourth quarter is expected to be “not a weak season,” with both revenue and gross margin likely to improve over Q3. The company forecasts a strong finish in 2026, and both full‑year revenue and profit have the potential to reach record highs for the Yageo Group.

Advanced semiconductor packaging firm ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 29th. For Q4, ASE projects that, assuming an exchange rate of NT$31.9 per US$1, consolidated group revenue will increase by 6%‑8% quarter‑over‑quarter. In response to continued strong demand for advanced packaging, the company announced an additional US$1 billion of capital expenditure for 2026, raising the total from US$10.5 billion to US$11.5 billion – a new historical high.

The National Development Council released its September 2026 economic outlook on the 29th. The composite score for economic‑policy signals rose to 41 points, up one point from the August revised figure of 40, and the warning light has stayed red for ten consecutive months, the longest red‑light streak since the pandemic. This expansion wave is mainly driven by strong production momentum in AI‑related industries, pushing industrial and service‑sector overtime hours into the yellow‑red zone. At the same time, both leading and coincident indicators continue to rise, confirming that Taiwan’s economy is on a steady growth path. Director‑General Chen Mei‑ju of the Economic Development Department highlighted three key points, expressing confidence that exports, investment and consumption will continue to act as the main engines lifting the economy.

The Taiwan Semiconductor Industry Association (TSIA) held its 30th‑anniversary conference on the 29th. 針對市場關注的關稅與地緣政治議題，亞德客表示，雖然許多客戶前往海外布局新產能，但其設備供應鏈仍高度依賴中國的高效與低成本優勢。亞德客作為上游氣動元件供應商，透過中國設備商整機出口海外，反而成為地緣政治下的間接受惠者。此外，隨著全球關稅壁壘提高，部分傳統產業客戶近期也重新將產能拉回中國，帶動機床、通用機械、包裝與紡織等傳統需求在 2027 年有望延續雙位數成長。
在線性滑軌業務方面，儘管面臨市場部分價格競爭，亞德客憑藉品質與交期優勢，市占率持續擴大。目前產能稼動率已提升至 40% 以上，目標 2026 年底達 50%(毛利率約 30%)；若稼動率能突破 80%，毛利率可進一步提升至 40%。公司預估，2027 年線性滑軌營收將出現超過 30% 的高成長，長期目標在 10 年內挑戰人民幣 30 億元規模。
而電控系統相關毛利率高達 60%，今年持續維持雙位數成長，未來 10 年也具備人民幣 30 億元的市場潛力。電動缸方面，亞德客持續布局關鍵零組件自製，未來可望應用於人形機器人與自動化機械手臂的龐大商機。
至於半導體專用元件，受惠於中國在地化採購政策，正積極切入半導體前後端製程客戶。公司透露，開發進度略快於預期，部分產品已提前於今年第四季逐步出貨並貢獻營收，10 年內目標年營收達 10 億人民幣。透過過去累積的通用規格產品支援半導體客戶，相關月營收已從一年前的 500 萬人民幣，顯著提升至目前的 1,300 萬人民幣。
展望第四季，曹永祥表示，雖然第四季通常是產業淡季，但依據目前客戶的反饋與訂單能見度，預期本季營收將與第三季持平，表現優於往年的季節性下滑。全年來看，公司維持人民幣計價營收成長超過 20%、營業利益率挑戰 34% 的目標不變。
曹永祥指出，亞德客近年財務體質健全、現金流充沛，正積極透過提高現金股利發放率來回饋股東，將從 55% 提升至 65%，且未來幾年配發率甚至有望再調高，展現對未來營運的高度信心。
paras_en: Adtek-KY (1590‑TW), a major pneumatic‑component maker, held an analyst day on the 29th. Its EPS for the first three quarters reached NT$44.14, already surpassing the full‑year figure of last year. Spokesperson Cao Yong‑Xiang said the recovery in traditional industries, strong demand for AI and automation, and three growth engines – linear guide rails, electric‑control systems and semiconductor‑specific components – are driving performance. He expects Q4 operations to beat the usual seasonal weakness and stay roughly flat quarter‑over‑quarter; by 2027 the linear guide‑rail business is projected to deliver more than 30% annual growth.

Adtek released its unaudited Q3 and nine‑month results. In RMB terms, Q3 consolidated revenue was RMB 2.427 billion, gross margin 49.4%, gross profit RMB 1.198 billion, operating profit RMB 823 million and net profit after tax RMB 600 million. In New Taiwan dollars, Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$11.512 billion, net profit NT$2.847 billion and EPS NT$14.23.

For the first three quarters, Adtek reported consolidated revenue of RMB 7.238 billion and net profit of RMB 1.897 billion. In NT$ terms, revenue was NT$33.69 billion, net profit NT$8.828 billion and EPS NT$44.14, beating last year’s NT$42 EPS and setting a new historical high.

Addressing market concerns about tariffs and geopolitics, Adtek said that although many customers are setting up new capacity overseas, its equipment supply chain still heavily relies on China’s efficiency and low‑cost advantages. As an upstream pneumatic‑component supplier, Adtek exports fully assembled machines through Chinese equipment makers, making it an indirect beneficiary of geopolitical shifts. Moreover, with global tariff barriers rising, some traditional‑industry customers are bringing capacity back to China, which should sustain double‑digit growth in machine tools, general machinery, packaging and textiles through 2027.

In the linear guide‑rail segment, despite some price competition, Adtek’s quality and delivery advantages are expanding market share. Current capacity utilization has risen above 40% with a target of 50% by the end of 2026 (gross margin around 30%). If utilization can exceed 80%, gross margin could rise to 40%. The company forecasts over 30% revenue growth for linear guide rails in 2027 and aims to reach RMB 3 billion in scale within ten years.

The electric‑control system business enjoys gross margins up to 60% and has maintained double‑digit growth this year; it also has a RMB 3 billion market potential over the next decade. In the electric‑cylinder area, Adtek continues to develop key components in‑house, positioning itself for the large opportunities in humanoid robots and automated robotic arms.

Regarding semiconductor‑specific components, Adtek is benefiting from China’s local‑procurement policy and is actively entering front‑ and back‑end semiconductor customers. The company disclosed that development is slightly ahead of schedule, with some products already shipping in Q4 and contributing revenue. The ten‑year target is RMB 1 billion annual revenue. Leveraging previously accumulated generic‑spec products for semiconductor clients, monthly revenue has risen from RMB 5 million a year ago to RMB 13 million today.

Looking ahead to Q4, Cao Yong‑Xiang said that although the quarter is usually a seasonal low, current customer feedback and order visibility suggest revenue will be flat with Q3, outperforming the typical seasonal decline. For the full year, the company maintains its goal of over 20% revenue growth in RMB terms and an operating margin target of 34%.

Cao noted that Adtek’s financial health and cash flow have been strong in recent years. The company plans to raise its cash dividend payout ratio from 55% to 65% and may increase it further in the coming years, reflecting high confidence in future operations.
