paras_en: The dollar slipped slightly on Thursday (the 29th) as forex market participants digested the Federal Reserve’s and European Central Bank’s rate decisions, while the euro edged up modestly. Both central banks, as widely expected, left rates unchanged. Meanwhile, after the UK unveiled its first budget under Andy Burnham, the pound continued its rally for a second consecutive trading day.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.2% to 102.02.

The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10‑2 on Wednesday to keep the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The outcome was broadly in line with market expectations, following the Fed’s first rate increase in over three years back in September.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the decision that the economy has shown strong momentum recently and the central bank remains committed to achieving its 2% annual inflation goal, but he declined to provide any forward guidance on future rate moves. Markets currently expect the Fed to raise rates at its final meeting in December.

Warsh added, “Since we took policy action in September, the financial and credit environment has begun to show some changes. As we anticipated, financial and credit conditions for some businesses and households have tightened. Market participants have also become more cautious in capital allocation.”

He continued, “Although the overall financial environment has tightened, I am reluctant to label it as ‘tightening.’ Nonetheless, overall these developments help pave the way for more durable, sustained economic growth and price stability.”
Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, noted that the latter part of Warsh’s remarks was the most critical segment of the press conference.

Adams explained, “That statement carries three implications. First, the Fed sees reason to hike further because ‘moving in that direction’ signals the target has not yet been met. Second, the Fed wants to make a moderate mid‑cycle adjustment rather than push rates to a level that would trigger a severe economic slowdown. Third, even though Warsh says he would like to abandon forward guidance, the Fed is still using that tool.”
Warsh also pointed out that a large amount of economic data will be released before the December meeting, allowing the Fed to assess the numbers before deciding on any further policy adjustments.
The data‑release wave kicked off on Thursday, with investors awaiting U.S. third‑quarter GDP and key September inflation figures.
Preliminary estimates from the Bureau of Economic Analysis show real GDP grew 3.4% in Q3, up from 2.2% in Q2 and ahead of economists’ 3.2% forecast.
Meanwhile, the inflation gauge most favored by the Fed – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, with core PCE up 0.3%.

On an annual basis, overall PCE increased 3.6% and core PCE edged up to 3.1%. All four numbers matched market expectations, but the annual rates show inflation picking up from August and remaining well above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target.
ECB Holds Rates Steady, Euro Edges Higher
The euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1162.

The European Central Bank earlier announced it would keep its three main policy rates unchanged, mirroring the Fed’s decision. The move was widely anticipated. Like the Fed, markets now expect the ECB to raise rates in December.
In its statement, the ECB noted that energy prices “continue to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.”

ECB officials added that the full impact of the energy shock is still unfolding, while underlying price growth “has so far remained broadly stable.” They also said financing conditions have tightened since the last meeting.
The bank also announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down next year, ending her originally eight‑year term early. She has been at the helm for just over seven years.

Deutsche Bank economist Mark Wall said, “Predicting the ECB’s policy path is becoming increasingly difficult. One question is whether the two prior hikes, combined with the tightening financial environment since September, are enough to curb the risk of rising energy‑driven inflation. The answer may well be no.”

He continued, “Another question is whether the change in ECB leadership will affect next year’s decisions. We believe the institution’s importance outweighs any individual leader, but uncertainty remains. We expect another rate hike in December, taking the rate to 2.75%, with Lagarde still in charge, which could mark the end of this tightening cycle.”
UK Budget Wins Market Favor, Pound Continues Rise
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.3361, marking a second straight trading‑day gain.

UK Chancellor John Healey unveiled the budget on Wednesday, maintaining fiscal rules and avoiding additional borrowing without a funding source. The plan also confirmed that the Treasury will retain £15 billion (about $20.05 billion) of fiscal space for FY 2029/30, in line with major dealer expectations.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said on Wednesday, “The core principle of the autumn budget was ‘do no harm,’ and we think the chancellor achieved that. The biggest spending increase comes from off‑balance‑sheet investment. Measures to lower living costs and business operating costs also feature prominently in the budget.”
He added, “The chancellor has bought himself more time, but the UK’s fiscal situation is becoming increasingly delicate, and tougher choices lie ahead.”
As of about 5:40 a.m. Taiwan time on Friday (the 30th):

The dollar index was at 101.9232, up 0.0368%. The euro was at $1.1174, down 0.0537%. The pound was at $1.3373, down 0.0299%. The Australian dollar was at $0.7030, up 0.0142%. The USD/CAD rate was 1.3990, up 0.0143%. The USD/JPY rate was 157.6400, down 0.0380%.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉Alphabet狂瀉12% Marvell暴跌逾13% 拖累那指費半 標普終止連三紅
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Alphabet Plummets 12%, Marvell Slides Over 13% Dragging Down Nasdaq and Philly Semiconductor Indices; S&P Ends Three-Day Rally
paras: 美股主要指數週四 (29 日) 收黑，Alphabet 財報失色、自由現金流轉負，加上 Marvell 暴跌逾 13%，拖累那斯達克指數與費城半導體指數雙雙下跌逾 1%。
標普 500 指數也終止連三個交易日漲勢。被視為「景氣風向球」的開拓重工走低，則壓抑道瓊表現。不過，標普成分股仍有逾 400 檔上漲，顯示賣壓集中於部分科技權值股，資金轉向其他產業。
Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 重挫約 12%，第三季調整後每股盈餘與營收均低於市場預期，自由現金流連續2季陷入負值。公司維持全年資本支出預估於 1,950 億至 2,050 億美元，龐大投資與財報表現之間的落差，再度引發市場對 AI 投資回報的疑慮。
週四盤後時段，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 因支出隨著滿足 AI 服務需求而大幅攀升，股價走低；英特爾 (INTC-US) 公布的營收展望則不如市場預期。
經濟數據方面，美國第三季經濟成長速度創一年來最快，9 月個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數月增 0.5%，為六個月來最大增幅。經濟韌性與通膨壓力並存，使聯準會 (Fed) 後續利率政策持續受到關注。
Fed 週三維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於 3.75% 至 4.00%，符合市場預期。此前，聯準會已於 9 月升息 1 碼。
白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特 (Kevin Hassett) 週四點評，若 10 月通膨數據明顯偏高，Fed 採取行動將是適當的，暗示聯準會仍可能再度升息。
科技股下跌也帶動避險買盤流入美債，短天期公債表現較佳。油價則震盪，交易員持續評估美國對伊朗軍事策略方向的相互矛盾訊號。
美股週四 (29 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌不一。Meta (META-US) 上漲 1.96%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.48%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 慘崩 12.64%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 0.16%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 大跌 4.25%。
費城半導體族群主要個股跌多漲少。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 2.08%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 1.94%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.80%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 1.36%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 1.33%。
記憶體與儲存族群普遍走低。美光 (MU-US) 大跌 4.98%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 0.25%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 大跌 5.32%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 0.36%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 1.58%。
台股 ADR 漲跌互見。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.75%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.43%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 大跌 4.14%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 0.83%。
企業新聞
Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 週四下殺超 12% 至每股 283.82 美元，第三季財報顯示，自由現金流為負 90.7 億美元；核心搜尋業務營收達 633.5 億美元，低於分析師預估的 649.6 億美元。整體營收為 1,275.8 億美元，也未達 LSEG 調查預估的 1,282.2 億美元。
儘管第三季獲利與營收優於市場預期，開拓重工(CAT-US) 股價仍狂瀉逾 9%。調整後每股盈餘為 7.20 美元、營收為 206.8 億美元，高於 LSEG 調查預估的 7.08 美元與 205.5 億美元。不過，旗下營建產業部門銷售額略低於預期。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 則由漲轉跌，終場小幅收黑，報每股530.14 美元。受惠於 Azure 雲端基礎設施業務成長，微軟截至 9 月的 2027 會計年度第一季營收與獲利均優於分析師預期，但其資本支出承諾低於預期，也使市場關注基礎設施合作夥伴交付資料中心容量的進度。
DoorDash 宣布，將以每股 65 美元收購 Instacart 母公司 Maplebear，較後者週三收盤價溢價 11%。DoorDash 同時公布第三季營收與息稅折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 均優於預期。Maplebear (CART-US) 股價下跌逾 2%，DoorDash (DASH-US) 則強漲超5%。
ServiceNow (NOW-US) 訂閱業務營收展望符合預期，但未能化解市場對 AI 可能衝擊其軟體業務的疑慮，其股價慘摔26.95% 至每股 109.67 美元，創該公司在美國上市以來最慘日。
禮來 (Eli Lilly)(LLY-US) 第三季業績大幅超越預期，股價強漲 6.46%。調整後每股盈餘達 7.48 美元，高於 LSEG 調查預估的 6.26 美元；營收達 244 億美元，也優於分析師預估的 226.1 億美元。
《彭博》引述消息人士報導，Marvell (MRVL-US) 正洽談收購資料中心光學設備製造商 Lumentum (LITE-US)，最快可能於下週宣布交易。消息帶動 Lumentum 股價震盪收紅約 0.6%，Marvell 則暴跌逾 13%。
華爾街分析
B. Riley Wealth Management 市場策略師Art Hogan 表示，相較於 8 月與 9 月，科技股在 10 月及邁向 11 月之際，已處於較穩定的位置，但投資人選股態度更加挑剔，個別企業發布的消息仍可能明顯影響行情。
摩根士丹利旗下 E*Trade 交易與投資部門主管 Chris Larkin 認為，週四走勢可視為 10 月市場的縮影：AI 交易疑慮壓抑科技與通訊服務類股，其他市場領域受到的衝擊則相對有限。
BMO Capital Markets 美國利率策略主管 Ian Lyngen 指出，最新數據再次顯示美國經濟強勁，但通膨壓力仍在，成長動能同時來自 AI 基礎建設與消費。
道明證券分析師則認為，經濟韌性具有廣泛基礎，加上 AI 帶動的通膨壓力，也解釋了 Fed 為何上調對經濟成長的評估，同時持續緊盯通膨目標。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: U.S. major indices closed lower on Thursday (the 29th), with Alphabet’s earnings disappointing and free cash flow turning negative, and Marvell tumbling more than 13%, pulling both the Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down over 1%.

The S&P 500 also ended its three‑day winning streak. Caterpillar, seen as a bellwether for the economy, fell, weighing on the Dow. Still, more than 400 S&P constituents rose, showing that selling pressure was concentrated in a few large‑cap tech stocks while capital shifted to other sectors.

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slumped about 12% as its Q3 adjusted EPS and revenue both missed market expectations and free cash flow was negative for a second straight quarter. The company kept its full‑year cap‑ex outlook at $195‑$205 billion, and the gap between massive spending and weak results reignited doubts about AI investment returns.
In after‑hours trading on Thursday, Amazon (AMZN‑US) fell as spending surged to meet AI service demand, and Intel’s (INTC‑US) revenue outlook came in below expectations.

On the economic data side, U.S. Q3 growth was the fastest in a year, and the September personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 0.5% month‑over‑month, the biggest gain in six months. The mix of economic resilience and inflation pressure keeps Fed policy in focus.
The Fed on Wednesday left its federal‑funds target range at 3.75%‑4.00%, in line with market expectations. Earlier, the central bank had raised rates by one quarter point in September.

White House National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett said on Thursday that if October inflation data comes in markedly high, Fed action would be appropriate, hinting another rate hike remains possible.

Tech‑stock declines also spurred a flight to safety into U.S. Treasuries, with short‑term bonds outperforming. Oil prices wavered as traders continued to assess mixed signals about U.S. military strategy toward Iran.
U.S. stock‑market performance on Thursday (the 29th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 132.54 points, or 0.25%, to 52,342.56. The Nasdaq slipped 365.13 points, or 1.38%, to 26,184.72. The S&P 500 dropped 23.59 points, or 0.30%, to 7,720.39. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 165.80 points, or 1.42%, to 11,518.20. The NYSE FANG+ Index declined 395.74 points, or 2.14%, to 18,132.04.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, performance was mixed. Meta (META‑US) rose 1.96%; Apple (AAPL‑US) gained 1.48%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) crashed 12.64%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) slipped 0.16%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) plunged 4.25%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor sector saw more decliners than gainers. AMD (AMD‑US) fell 2.08%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) dropped 1.94%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) slipped 0.80%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) rose 1.36%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) gained 1.33%.

Memory and storage stocks were broadly down. Micron (MU‑US) tumbled 4.98%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) slipped 0.25%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) fell 5.32%; Seagate (STX‑US) edged up 0.36%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) dropped 1.58%.
Taiwan‑related ADRs were mixed. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) fell 1.75%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) rose 1.43%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) plunged 4.14%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) gained 0.83%.
Corporate news

Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slashed more than 12% on Thursday to $283.82 per share. The Q3 report showed a negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion; core search revenue was $63.35 billion, below analysts’ $64.96 billion forecast. Total revenue came in at $127.58 billion, also missing the LSEG consensus of $128.22 billion.

Even though Caterpillar (CAT‑US) beat earnings and revenue expectations, its stock plunged more than 9%. Adjusted EPS was $7.20 and revenue $20.68 billion, ahead of LSEG estimates of $7.08 and $20.55 billion, but its construction‑equipment segment sales were slightly below forecast.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US) turned from a gain to a loss, closing marginally lower at $530.14. Benefiting from Azure cloud growth, Microsoft’s Q1 FY2027 revenue and profit were above expectations, yet its capital‑expenditure commitment fell short, raising questions about the pace of data‑center capacity delivery by infrastructure partners.

DoorDash announced a $65‑per‑share acquisition of Instacart parent Maplebear, an 11% premium to the latter’s Wednesday close. DoorDash also reported Q3 revenue and EBITDA that beat forecasts. Maplebear (CART‑US) fell more than 2%, while DoorDash (DASH‑US) surged over 5%.

ServiceNow (NOW‑US) met its subscription‑revenue outlook but failed to allay concerns that AI could hit its software business, sending the stock down 26.95% to $109.67, its worst day since listing in the U.S.

Eli Lilly (LLY‑US) posted a Q3 performance far above expectations, lifting the share price 6.46%. Adjusted EPS hit $7.48 versus the LSEG estimate of $6.26, and revenue reached $24.4 billion, beating the analyst forecast of $22.61 billion.

Bloomberg reported that Marvell (MRVL‑US) is in talks to acquire data‑center optics maker Lumentum (LITE‑US), with a deal possibly announced as early as next week. The news sent Lumentum’s stock up about 0.6% and Marvell’s tumbling more than 13%.
Wall Street commentary

B. Riley Wealth Management market strategist Art Hogan said that compared with August and September, tech stocks are in a more stable position as we move into October and toward November, but investors are being pickier, and individual company news can still move the market sharply.

Morgan Stanley’s E*Trade head of trading and investing, Chris Larkin, viewed Thursday’s action as a micro‑cosm of the October market: AI‑related concerns are weighing on tech and communications‑services stocks, while other sectors feel relatively limited impact.

Ian Lyngen, head of U.S. rates strategy at BMO Capital Markets, noted that the latest data again show a strong U.S. economy, but inflation pressures persist, with growth momentum coming from both AI infrastructure and consumer spending.

Daiwa Securities analysts argued that economic resilience rests on a broad base, and AI‑driven inflation pressures help explain why the Fed has upgraded its growth outlook while still keeping a close eye on its inflation target.

items.title: ServiceNow暴跌27%淪史上最大單日跌幅 財報再掀AI顛覆疑慮
items.title_en: ServiceNow Plummets 27%, Marking Its Largest One‑Day Drop in History as Earnings Revive AI Disruption Concerns
paras: 《CNBC》報導，ServiceNow (NOW-US) 股價週四(29日)重挫26.95%，為公司史上最大單日跌幅，這家企業軟體商的第三季財報表現不如預期，再度引發市場對AI可能顛覆傳統軟體產業的擔憂。
花旗分析師 Tyler Radke 表示，「以 ServiceNow 的表現標準來看，這次有點不尋常，主要是財報超出預期的幅度不足。」
ServiceNow第三季營收年增逾20%，達41.1億美元，大致符合LSEG調查分析師預估的41億美元。調整後每股盈餘(EPS)則不如預期，為1美元，低於市場預估的1.02美元。
這份財報未能有效消除市場近期對「軟體即服務末日」(SaaSpocalypse)的擔憂，也就是市場憂慮新的AI能力可能顛覆傳統軟體商業模式。
即使 ServiceNow 小幅上調2026全年訂閱營收展望至157.8億至157.9億美元，股價仍大幅下跌。此外，AI業務新增合約價值的平均金額也大增65%。
Radke 表示，令投資人感到不安的因素之一，是公司投資新成立的「前線部署工程團隊」，卻尚未立即展現成效。這個團隊會進駐企業內部，協助客戶打造AI解決方案。
他指出，「這還需要再等一段時間，因此我認為市場希望能更早看到成果。要真正看到成長出現轉折，我想可能得等到明年。」
paras_en: CNBC reported that ServiceNow (NOW-US) shares tumbled 26.95% on Thursday (the 29th), marking the biggest single‑day decline in the company’s history after its third‑quarter earnings fell short of expectations, reigniting market worries that AI could upend the traditional software industry.
Citi analyst Tyler Radke said, "By ServiceNow’s own performance standards, this is a bit unusual, mainly because the earnings beat was not large enough."

ServiceNow’s third‑quarter revenue grew more than 20% year‑over‑year to $4.11 billion, roughly in line with LSEG analysts’ forecast of $4.1 billion. Adjusted earnings per share came in at $1.00, below the market expectation of $1.02.
The results failed to allay recent market concerns about a potential “SaaSpocalypse,” where new AI capabilities could disrupt traditional software business models.

Even though ServiceNow modestly raised its full‑year 2026 subscription revenue outlook to $15.78 billion‑$15.79 billion, the stock still fell sharply, while the average contract value of new AI business deals jumped 65%.

Radke noted that one unsettling factor for investors is the company’s investment in a newly created “front‑line deployment engineering team,” which has yet to show immediate results. This team will embed within enterprises to help customers build AI solutions.
He added, "That will take some more time, so I think the market wants to see results sooner. To really see a turning point in growth, I think we may have to wait until next year."

items.title: 美光下挫5%！記憶體股面臨「高標」考驗 三星財報亮眼仍難滿足市場
items.title_en: Micron Slides 5% as Memory Stocks Face a ‘High Bar’ Test; Samsung’s Strong Earnings Still Fall Short of Market Expectations
paras: 記憶體同業三星電子周四公布獲利連四季刷新紀錄，當天股價卻下挫4.1%，凸顯出市場對記憶體類股的要求有多高，美光(MU-US)這次也成了市場高期待下的受害者
美光周四股價下跌5%，收在每股934.27美元。
記憶體晶片業者創造龐大利潤，幾乎已成常態，三星也是如此。在晶片部門帶動下，三星上季淨利較去年同期暴增逾五倍，達75.136兆韓元(561.5億美元)，營業利益年增近八倍且突破100兆韓元整數門檻，營收也增為去年同期的兩倍以上。
但因為三星大致重申先前已公布的初步財報內容與股東回報計畫，並未帶來新的驚喜，似乎讓股東感到失望。這與南韓同業SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)形成對比，該公司周三公布財報時，宣布計劃向股東返還750億美元。
Counterpoint Research研究總監MS Hwang說：「三星公布財報後股價下跌，原因是股東回報計畫沒有帶來超出預期的驚喜。這凸顯在市場期待居高不下的情況下，投資人面臨的真正挑戰。」

美光下一關：大規模庫藏股計畫

美光接下來的考驗，是何時能啟動大規模股票回購。根據該公司2024年美國《晶片法案》(CHIPS Act)補助資金的相關條件，美光最快可於12月9日開始大規模實施庫藏股。
瑞銀(UBS)分析師Timothy Arcuri預估，美光每年回購股票的規模最高可達2,000億美元。
花旗分析師Atif Malik同樣看好美光，重申該股目標價為1,300美元。他周四說：「美光近期核准創紀錄的352億美元股票回購計畫，將有能力大幅提高股東回報。」
Malik說：「這項授權凸顯管理層對自由現金流能持續創造的信心，也反映出DRAM供需結構將持續趨緊，並延續至2027至2028年。」
paras_en: Memory‑chip peer Samsung Electronics reported record‑breaking profits for the fourth consecutive quarter on Thursday, yet its stock fell 4.1% that day, underscoring how lofty the market’s expectations are for memory stocks. Micron (MU‑US) became another victim of those high hopes.
Micron’s shares dropped 5% on Thursday, closing at $934.27 per share.

Profits in the memory‑chip business have become almost routine, and Samsung is no exception. Driven by its chip division, Samsung’s net profit for the latest quarter surged more than five‑fold year‑over‑year to 75.136 trillion won ($56.15 billion), operating profit jumped nearly eight‑fold to break the 100‑trillion‑won threshold, and revenue more than doubled versus the same period last year.

However, because Samsung essentially reiterated the preliminary earnings figures and shareholder‑return plan it had already disclosed, offering no fresh surprises, shareholders appeared disappointed. This contrasts with South Korean rival SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), which on Wednesday announced a plan to return $75 billion to shareholders when it released its earnings.

Counterpoint Research director MS Hwang said, “Samsung’s stock fell after the earnings release because the shareholder‑return plan didn’t exceed expectations. This highlights the real challenge investors face when market expectations remain sky‑high.”
Micron’s next hurdle: launching a large‑scale share‑repurchase program. Under the conditions of the company’s 2024 U.S. CHIPS Act funding, Micron could begin a major buyback as early as December 9.
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri estimates Micron could repurchase up to $200 billion of its own stock each year.

Citigroup analyst Atif Malik also remains bullish on Micron, reaffirming a target price of $1,300. He said on Thursday, “Micron’s recently approved record‑setting $35.2 billion share‑repurchase plan will significantly boost shareholder returns.”
Malik added, “This authorization reflects management’s confidence in the continued generation of free cash flow and signals that the DRAM supply‑demand balance will stay tight through 2027‑2028.”

items.title: 日銀利率暫留1.25% 分析師估12月升至1.5% 終點上看2%
items.title_en: BOJ Keeps Rate at 1.25% – Analysts See 1.5% Rise in December, Target Around 2%
paras: 日本銀行 (日銀) 預計在周五 (30日) 結束的貨幣政策會議上維持基準利率於1.25%不變，但可能在最新季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的通膨預測，並強調日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。這將顯示日銀政策重心正從長期刺激通膨，轉向防止物價漲幅超標，為最快12月再次升息保留空間。
《路透社》報導指出，日銀此次預計不會連續兩次會議升息，而是希望進一步觀察先前升息對銀行放款條件與金融環境的影響。不過，日銀可能藉由政策聲明釋出更明確的訊號，表明未來將持續調升利率，逐步使利率接近不刺激、也不抑制經濟活動的中性水準。

這項政策轉向將延續日銀上月傳達的訊息。分析人士指出，日銀已進入較為重視抑制通膨風險的政策階段，未來可能每隔數個月升息一次。瑞穗研究所 (Mizuho Research Institute) 執行經濟學家、日銀前高層門間一夫表示，人工智慧 (AI) 投資帶來的全球價格壓力相當強勁，近期通膨有一部分是由需求增加所推動。他認為，日銀若確認政策方向已經轉變，等於向市場傳達可能每季升息的訊號，並預測日銀可能在12月及明年3月升息。
日銀總裁植田和男會後記者會的談話，也將成為市場觀察未來升息時點與幅度的重要依據。熟悉日銀想法的人士向《路透社》透露，日銀可能在季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的物價預測，並指出日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。隨著薪資成長逐漸穩定，企業與家庭的通膨預期也維持在約2%，日銀可能強調，接下來的政策任務是透過逐步升息，讓通膨穩定在目標附近。
日本通膨壓力仍是日銀考慮進一步緊縮政策的主要原因。9月核心消費者物價通膨率在睽違9個月後再次超過日銀2%的目標，中東衝突延長推升燃料成本，也削弱政府燃料補貼對物價的抑制效果。日銀7月公布的季度預測原本就預期，隨著企業持續將成本上升轉嫁給消費者，未來數月通膨可能加速。
日元走弱同樣加劇物價壓力。日元貶值推高進口商品成本，能源價格居高不下則進一步增加企業與家庭負擔。日銀今年6月升息後，9月再度調高利率，兩次升息間隔已短於2024年與2025年大約每年升息兩次的節奏，顯示政策正常化速度正在加快。
根據《路透社》對分析師的調查，多數受訪者預期日銀最快在12月將政策利率由1.25%提高至1.5%，之後明年仍會繼續升息。分析師對本輪升息周期終點利率的預估，主要落在1.75%至2%之間。若日銀明確表示基礎通膨已達到與2%目標一致的水準，市場可能將此解讀為央行不願容忍通膨進一步超標，未來升息步伐也可能更加靈活。
不過，日銀仍須在控制物價與維持經濟穩定之間取得平衡。若過早或過快升息，可能對企業融資、銀行放款及整體經濟活動造成影響；若通膨壓力持續擴大，則可能迫使央行加快緊縮步伐。因此，即使此次會議預計按兵不動，市場仍將密切觀察日銀是否調整通膨預測，以及植田和男對未來政策路徑的說明。
日銀政策轉向也與全球通膨環境相互呼應。AI產業投資熱潮推升部分商品與服務需求，中東衝突則造成能源供應與價格風險，美國與歐洲央行同樣面臨通膨壓力升高的挑戰。對日本而言，能源成本上升、日元偏弱與薪資成長逐步擴散，正共同影響物價走勢。
整體而言，日銀此次會議的關鍵不只在於是否維持1.25%的利率，更在於能否清楚傳達下一階段的政策方向。若日銀確認基礎通膨已接近目標，並上修未來物價預測，將進一步強化市場對12月升息的預期；但實際升息時間與後續幅度，仍取決於通膨、薪資、匯率及金融環境的變化。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1.25% at the monetary‑policy meeting ending on Friday (the 30th), but may slightly raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the latest quarterly outlook and stress that core inflation has basically reached the 2% target. This would show the BOJ’s focus shifting from long‑term stimulus to preventing price gains from overshooting, leaving room for a possible rate hike as early as December.

Reuters reported that the BOJ does not plan to raise rates at two consecutive meetings, preferring to watch how the previous hike affects banks’ lending conditions and the broader financial environment. However, the central bank may use its policy statement to send a clearer signal that it will keep tightening, gradually moving rates toward a neutral level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic activity.

This policy shift continues the message the BOJ delivered last month. Analysts say the bank has entered a phase that places greater emphasis on curbing inflation risks and may raise rates every few months. Mizuho Research Institute senior economist and former BOJ official Kazuo Kadokawa noted that AI‑driven investment is creating strong global price pressure and that recent inflation is partly demand‑driven. He believes that once the BOJ confirms the policy turn, it will signal to the market a possible quarterly hike and forecasts rate increases in December and March next year.

Comments by BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting will be a key reference for the market on the timing and magnitude of future hikes. Sources familiar with the BOJ told Reuters that the bank may modestly lift its price outlook for the next fiscal year in the quarterly outlook and point out that core inflation has essentially hit the 2% goal. With wage growth stabilising, firms and households expect inflation around 2%, and the BOJ may stress that its next task is to bring inflation close to target through gradual rate hikes.

Inflation pressure in Japan remains the main reason the BOJ is considering further tightening. Core CPI in September again exceeded the 2% target for the first time in nine months, while the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed fuel costs higher and weakened the effect of government fuel subsidies. The BOJ’s July quarterly forecast already anticipated that, as firms keep passing higher costs onto consumers, inflation could accelerate in the coming months.

A weaker yen also amplifies price pressure. Yen depreciation raises the cost of imported goods, and persistently high energy prices further increase the burden on firms and households. After the BOJ’s June hike, it raised rates again in September, with the interval between hikes now shorter than the roughly semi‑annual rhythm expected for 2024‑25, indicating an accelerating pace of policy normalisation.

A Reuters poll of analysts found most expect the BOJ to lift the policy rate from 1.25% to 1.5% as early as December, with further hikes likely next year. Analysts’ forecasts for the end‑point of this tightening cycle cluster around 1.75%‑2%. If the BOJ explicitly states that core inflation has reached the 2% target, markets may read that as a sign the central bank will not tolerate further overshoot, making future hikes potentially more flexible.

Nevertheless, the BOJ must balance price control with economic stability. Raising rates too early or too quickly could hurt corporate financing, bank lending and overall activity, while persistent inflation pressure could force a faster tightening. Hence, even if the meeting ends with a hold, markets will watch closely for any revision to inflation forecasts and Governor Ueda’s guidance on the policy path ahead.

The BOJ’s policy turn also mirrors the global inflation environment. AI‑driven investment is boosting demand for certain goods and services, the Middle‑East conflict is creating energy‑supply and price risks, and central banks in the US and Europe face similar inflation‑driving challenges. For Japan, rising energy costs, a soft yen and gradually expanding wages are jointly shaping price dynamics.

Overall, the key to this BOJ meeting is not only whether the 1.25% rate is maintained but also whether the bank can clearly convey its next‑stage policy direction. If the BOJ confirms core inflation is near target and upgrades its price outlook, it will reinforce market expectations of a December hike; however, the actual timing and size of any future moves will still depend on developments in inflation, wages, exchange rates and the financial environment.

items.title: 〈財報〉亞馬遜Q3營收、獲利均遜色 自由現金流流出424億美元 盤後一度挫逾7%
items.title_en: Amazon Q3 Revenue and Profit Miss Expectations, Free Cash Flow Outflow $42.4 B, After-Hours Stock Fell Over 7%
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 第三季財報表現不如華爾街預期，且人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施投資持續消耗現金，加上第四季假期購物旺季營收展望未能帶來明顯驚喜，股價周四 (29日) 盤後一度下跌逾7%。儘管亞馬遜雲端服務 (AWS) 營收年增近四成，成為本季主要亮點，但零售與廣告業務表現疲弱，加上公司維持全年2,200億美元資本支出計畫，市場仍關注巨額AI投資何時能轉化為更強勁的現金流與財務回報。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團 (LSEG) 彙整的分析師預估，亞馬遜第三季每股盈餘為1.89美元，低於市場預期的1.96美元；營收為2,019.4億美元，也略低於預估的2,023.1億美元。不過，營收仍較去年同期的1,801.7億美元成長12%；若排除匯率變動造成的約9億美元不利影響，營收年增率為13%。

亞馬遜第三季主要財報數據如下：



亞馬遜第三季淨利為206.9億美元，低於去年同期的211.9億美元；稀釋後每股盈餘則由去年同期的1.95美元降至1.89美元。公司指出，淨利下滑主要與去年第三季認列投資AI新創公司Anthropic帶來的95億美元稅前收益有關，這筆收益屬於非營業項目，墊高了去年同期的比較基期。
不過，亞馬遜第三季營業利益升至280.8億美元，較去年同期的174.2億美元大幅增加，營業利益率達13.9%，創公司歷史新高。北美業務營收年增6%至1,129億美元，營業利益由去年同期的48億美元增至87億美元；國際業務營收年增5%至431億美元，營業利益由12億美元增至16億美元。AWS營業利益則由去年同期的114億美元升至177.7億美元，顯示雲端業務不僅營收成長，也持續貢獻獲利。
AWS第三季營收年增39.3%至459.8億美元，高於市場預估的452.9億美元，成長速度為近五年來最快，並形成約1,840億美元的年化營收規模。執行長賈西 (Andy Jassy) 在財報聲明中表示，公司在AWS功能與基礎設施上的投資正逐漸發揮效果，並預期AWS在2027年與2028年的營收成長率都將超過40%。
面對投資人對AI支出效益的關注，亞馬遜也強調自家AI服務與晶片業務的進展。公司表示，Bedrock AI模型平台的市場需求持續增加，Trainium AI晶片與Graviton處理器業務也逐步擴大。賈西指出，亞馬遜晶片業務持續維持三位數的年增幅，並計畫在2027年底讓Trainium晶片對外部客戶開放使用，為先前提出的對外供應方向進一步設定時間表。
然而，AI基礎設施投資的資金需求也對自由現金流構成沉重壓力。亞馬遜連續第二季出現負自由現金流，截至9月底的過去12個月，自由現金流流出423.6億美元，較去年同期流入147.9億美元明顯惡化。上一季的過去12個月自由現金流流出為76億美元，代表資金消耗情況進一步擴大。
公司指出，自由現金流惡化主要是因為購置不動產與設備的支出增加，背後原因以AI相關投資為主。過去12個月，亞馬遜購置不動產與設備的淨支出年增948億美元；《路透社》報導亦指出，第三季相關資本支出達772.6億美元，約比市場預期高出200億美元。雖然同期過去12個月營業現金流年增29%至1,683億美元，但龐大的設備投資仍使自由現金流轉為大幅流出。
亞馬遜並未因此下修全年資本支出預測，仍預期2026年現金資本支出約達2,200億美元。賈西在與投資人的電話會議中更表示，公司預期2027年支出將「大幅高於」2026年，但同時強調，亞馬遜已能清楚看見這些投資帶來具吸引力財務回報的路徑。這番說法凸顯公司仍打算積極擴建AI運算與雲端基礎設施，而不是因短期現金流壓力大幅放慢投資。
其他大型科技公司近期也開始受到市場檢視。微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US) 本周將年度資本支出預測由1,750億美元下調至1,700億美元；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 則維持全年資本支出1,950億至2,050億美元的預測。相較之下，亞馬遜不僅維持2,200億美元的全年支出目標，執行長還預告明年將進一步增加投資，使市場更關注AI基礎設施建設的回報速度與現金流壓力。
亞馬遜零售與廣告業務的表現則相對疲弱。第三季線上商店營收年增2%至684.7億美元，低於市場預估的696.8億美元；廣告營收為196.4億美元，也低於市場預估的208.2億美元。依市場數據，廣告營收較去年同期下滑11%，但這項比較受到Prime Day促銷檔期調整影響。
亞馬遜今年將部分國家的年度Prime Day促銷活動從往年第三季提前至第二季，以避開7月舉行的國際足總世界盃 (FIFA World Cup) 賽事。去年Prime Day則完全落在第三季，因此促銷檔期改變影響本季線上零售與廣告收入的年增比較。亞馬遜表示，若排除匯率影響，第三季廣告營收年增12%，並預期第四季廣告營收成長率將回升至高十位數百分比。
展望第四季，亞馬遜預估營收將介於2,400億至2,470億美元，年增12%至16%，區間中值為2,435億美元，低於LSEG彙整的市場預估約2,445億美元。公司預期匯率變動將對第四季營收成長造成約60個基點的不利影響；營業利益則預估介於285億至335億美元，高於去年同期的250億美元。
第四季通常是亞馬遜全年營收最重要的季度之一，主要受年終假期購物旺季帶動。儘管公司預期營收仍將維持雙位數成長，市場仍將觀察消費者在燃料與生活成本偏高的環境下是否持續支出，以及亞馬遜能否藉由更快配送、擴大偏遠地區服務與改善零售利潤率，持續爭取電商市占率。
整體而言，亞馬遜第三季呈現兩種不同走勢：AWS以近五年最快的速度成長，營業利益與公司整體營業利益率也創下佳績；但線上零售與廣告業務未達市場預期，AI投資則讓自由現金流大幅轉負。公司維持2026年2,200億美元資本支出預測，並預告2027年投資還將增加，意味著接下來市場評價亞馬遜的關鍵，將不只在於AI與雲端業務能成長多快，也在於這些投入能否持續帶來足夠的營收、獲利與現金回報。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) reported third‑quarter results that fell short of Wall Street forecasts, and its AI infrastructure spending continued to drain cash. Combined with a lackluster holiday‑season revenue outlook for Q4, the stock slipped more than 7% in after‑hours trading on Thursday (the 29th). Although AWS revenue grew nearly 40% year‑over‑year, making it the quarter’s bright spot, weak retail and advertising performance and a full‑year capital‑expenditure plan of $220 billion kept investors focused on when massive AI investments will translate into stronger cash flow and financial returns.

According to analyst estimates compiled by LSEG, Amazon’s Q3 earnings per share were $1.89, below the consensus of $1.96; revenue came in at $201.94 billion, slightly under the $202.31 billion forecast. Nonetheless, revenue was up 12% from $180.17 billion a year earlier, and when the roughly $0.9 billion adverse currency impact is stripped out, the year‑over‑year growth rate is 13%.

Amazon’s Q3 key figures show net income of $20.69 billion, down from $21.19 billion a year ago, and diluted EPS fell from $1.95 to $1.89. The company said the profit decline mainly reflects a $9.5 billion pre‑tax gain from last year’s investment in AI startup Anthropic, which was a non‑operating item that inflated the prior‑year baseline.

Operating income, however, rose to $28.08 billion, up sharply from $17.42 billion a year earlier, delivering an operating margin of 13.9% – a company record. North America revenue grew 6% to $112.9 billion, with operating profit climbing from $4.8 billion to $8.7 billion. International revenue rose 5% to $43.1 billion, with operating profit increasing from $1.2 billion to $1.6 billion. AWS operating profit jumped from $11.4 billion to $17.77 billion, showing the cloud business is not only growing revenue but also contributing profit.

AWS Q3 revenue grew 39.3% year‑over‑year to $45.98 billion, beating the $45.29 billion consensus and marking the fastest growth in nearly five years, creating an annualized revenue run‑rate of about $184 billion. CEO Andy Jassy said AWS investments in features and infrastructure are beginning to pay off and expects AWS revenue growth rates to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028.

Addressing investor concerns about AI spending returns, Amazon highlighted progress in its AI services and chip businesses. Demand for the Bedrock AI model platform continues to rise, and the Trainium AI chip and Graviton processor lines are expanding. Jassy noted that Amazon’s chip segment is maintaining triple‑digit annual growth and plans to open Trainium to external customers by the end of 2027, setting a timetable for the previously announced external‑supply strategy.

AI infrastructure spending, however, has put heavy pressure on free cash flow. Amazon recorded a second consecutive quarter of negative free cash flow, with a 12‑month outflow of $42.36 billion as of the end of September, a sharp deterioration from the $14.79 billion inflow in the same period a year earlier. The prior quarter’s 12‑month outflow was $7.6 billion, indicating an accelerating cash drain.

The company said the free‑cash‑flow decline stems mainly from higher capital expenditures on property and equipment, driven largely by AI‑related investments. Over the past 12 months, net spending on property and equipment rose $94.8 billion year‑over‑year; Reuters reported Q3 capital spending of $77.26 billion, about $20 billion above market expectations. Although operating cash flow for the same 12‑month window grew 29% to $168.3 billion, the massive equipment outlays turned free cash flow into a large outflow.

Amazon has not cut its full‑year cap‑ex forecast, still expecting roughly $220 billion of cash capital spending in 2026. Jassy told investors that 2027 spending will be “significantly higher” than 2026, while emphasizing that the company can already see a clear path to attractive financial returns from these investments. This underscores Amazon’s intent to keep expanding AI compute and cloud infrastructure rather than slowing down due to short‑term cash‑flow pressure.

Other big‑tech peers are also under market scrutiny. Microsoft (MSFT-US) trimmed its annual cap‑ex outlook this week from $175 billion to $170 billion, while Alphabet (GOOGL-US) kept its full‑year cap‑ex guidance in the $195‑$205 billion range. By contrast, Amazon maintains a $220 billion annual spend target and its CEO signaled further increases next year, drawing attention to the speed and cash‑flow impact of AI infrastructure returns.

Amazon’s retail and advertising segments lagged. Q3 online store revenue grew 2% year‑over‑year to $68.47 billion, missing the $69.68 billion estimate, while ad revenue was $19.64 billion, also below the $20.82 billion forecast. Advertising revenue fell 11% versus a year ago, a dip partly affected by the timing shift of Prime Day promotions.

Amazon moved some countries’ annual Prime Day events from the usual Q3 slot to Q2 this year to avoid the July FIFA World Cup. Last year Prime Day fell entirely in Q3, so the shift altered the year‑over‑year comparison for online retail and ad revenue. Amazon said that, excluding currency effects, Q3 ad revenue grew 12% year‑over‑year and it expects Q4 ad growth to rebound to high‑double‑digit percentages.

Looking ahead to Q4, Amazon projects revenue between $240 billion and $247 billion, a 12%‑16% increase year‑over‑year, with a midpoint of $243.5 billion, slightly below LSEG’s consensus of about $244.5 billion. The company expects currency movements to shave roughly 60 basis points off Q4 revenue growth, and operating profit is forecast at $28.5 billion to $33.5 billion, above last year’s $25 billion.

Q4 is traditionally one of Amazon’s most important quarters, driven by the holiday shopping season. While the company expects double‑digit revenue growth, the market will watch whether consumers continue to spend amid higher fuel and living‑cost pressures, and whether Amazon can capture more e‑commerce share through faster delivery, expanded remote‑area services, and improved retail margins.

Overall, Amazon’s Q3 showed two divergent trends: AWS grew at its fastest pace in five years, delivering record operating profit and boosting the company‑wide margin, while online retail and advertising fell short of expectations and AI spending turned free cash flow sharply negative. The firm kept its 2026 $220 billion cap‑ex forecast and signaled higher 2027 investment, meaning the market’s assessment of Amazon will hinge not only on the speed of AI and cloud growth but also on whether those investments generate sufficient revenue, profit and cash returns.

items.title: SanDisk Q1營收年增378% 宣布1拆8股票分割
items.title_en: SanDisk Q1 Revenue Up 378% YoY Announces 1-for-8 Stock Split
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，重新成為獨立公司不到兩年，SanDisk(SNDK-US)計劃進行股票分割。
根據道瓊市場數據，自 2025 年 2 月與威騰電子(Western Digital)(WDC-US)分拆以來，SanDisk 股價已上漲逾 2,600%。該公司已成為標普 500 指數中股價最高成分股之一，週四(29日)收盤報 1,330 美元。截至當日，指數中只有五家公司的股價高於 SanDisk。
單看股價高低本身並沒有太大意義，尤其在投資人可以輕易買賣零股的時代。不過，股票分割會增加流通股數，並相應降低每股價格。企業通常表示，此舉能讓更多投資人更容易買進自家股票。
SanDisk 也不例外。該公司宣布將進行 1 拆 8 的股票分割，預計 11 月 19 日生效。公司指出，股價降低後，也有助於員工透過相關計畫購買公司股票。
股票分割不會改變公司整體價值，也不會改變各投資人持有的公司價值。至於股票分割是否真能讓股票更受散戶投資人青睞，相關研究的結論並不一致。不過，有些專家指出，股價降低具有一定的心理優勢，因為較低的價格看起來不會那麼令人卻步。
SanDisk 在公布財報時同步宣布股票分割計畫。公司預估，截至12月一季(2027會計年度第二季)營收將達 122 億至 126 億美元。FactSet 追蹤的分析師原先預估營收為 123 億美元。
SanDisk截至9月一季(Q1)營收達 110 億美元，較去年同期成長 378%，高於分析師預估的 107 億美元。
執行長 David Goeckeler 強調，公司產品「需求強勁且持續成長」，帶動「資料中心業務的成長速度超越其他業務」。
截至發稿，SanDisk股價週四盤後在震盪交易中下跌逾3%。
SanDisk 是人工智慧熱潮主要受惠者之一。AI 熱潮帶動儲存及傳輸資料相關產品的需求前所未有。由於旗下儲存產品供應吃緊，公司得以大幅調漲價格，並實現相當可觀的獲利成長。
在此背景下，SanDisk第一季調整後毛利率達 85.1%，代表公司在扣除產品製造成本後，能保留的營收比重。這項數據高於 截至6月一季的 84.6% 調整後毛利率。
SanDisk 預估，第二季調整後毛利率將介於 84.5% 至 85.5% 之間。
第一季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)暴增 6,913%，達 52.60 美元，高於市場預期的 46.67 美元。但公司也提醒，這項百分比「並不具實質意義」。
SanDisk 今年以來一直是標普 500 指數中表現最佳股票之一，2026 年迄今股價已上漲逾 450%，漲幅僅次於莫德納(Moderna)。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that less than two years after becoming an independent company again, SanDisk (SNDK-US) is planning a stock split.

According to Dow Jones market data, since the spin‑off from Western Digital (WDC-US) in February 2025, SanDisk’s share price has risen more than 2,600%. The company has become one of the highest‑priced constituents of the S&P 500, closing Thursday (the 29th) at $1,330. As of that day, only five companies in the index traded above SanDisk’s price.

Looking at the absolute price alone isn’t very meaningful, especially in an era where investors can easily trade fractional shares. However, a stock split increases the number of shares outstanding and correspondingly lowers the price per share. Companies usually say the move makes it easier for more investors to buy their stock.

SanDisk is no exception. The company announced a 1‑for‑8 stock split, expected to take effect on November 19. It noted that a lower share price also helps employees purchase company stock through related plans.

A stock split does not change the company’s overall value nor the value each investor holds. Whether a split truly makes a stock more attractive to retail investors is debated in research. Some experts point out that a lower price has a psychological advantage because it looks less intimidating.

SanDisk disclosed the split plan alongside its earnings release. The company projects Q2 of its 2027 fiscal year (the December quarter) revenue of $12.2 billion to $12.6 billion. FactSet‑tracked analysts had originally forecast $12.3 billion.
For the quarter ending September (Q1), SanDisk reported revenue of $11.0 billion, up 378% year‑over‑year and above analysts’ estimate of $10.7 billion.
Chief Executive David Goeckeler emphasized that the company’s products are experiencing "strong and sustained demand," driving data‑center business growth at a faster pace than other segments.
At the time of writing, SanDisk’s share price was down more than 3% in after‑hours trading on Thursday.

SanDisk is one of the primary beneficiaries of the AI boom. The surge in AI has created unprecedented demand for storage and data‑transfer products. Tight supply of its storage offerings has allowed the company to raise prices sharply and achieve substantial profit growth.

In this context, SanDisk’s adjusted gross margin for Q1 reached 85.1%, indicating the proportion of revenue retained after product‑manufacturing costs. This is higher than the 84.6% adjusted gross margin recorded for the quarter ending June.
SanDisk forecasts its adjusted gross margin for Q2 to be between 84.5% and 85.5%.
Adjusted earnings per share surged 6,913% in Q1 to $52.60, beating market expectations of $46.67, though the company cautioned that the percentage figure "has no substantive meaning."
Since the start of the year, SanDisk has been one of the best‑performing stocks in the S&P 500, with its price up more than 450% in 2026, second only to Moderna.

items.title: Alphabet暴跌觸發「死亡交叉」！最慘跌勢過了嗎？歷史數據曝轉機
items.title_en: Alphabet Plummets Triggering a "Death Cross"! Is the Worst Decline Over? Historical Data Suggests a Turning Point
paras: Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 第三季財報不如預期，核心搜尋業務成長放緩，拖累股價週四 (29 日) 暴跌逾 12%，並觸發技術面偏空的「死亡交叉」。不過，歷史數據顯示，Alphabet 過去十年出現這項訊號後，多數情況下半年後股價反而走高；另一項動能指標也降至逾 15 年低點，為這波跌勢是否接近尾聲留下想像空間。
《MarketWatch》報導，投資人近幾個月持續質疑 Alphabet 的人工智慧 (AI) 策略，股價早已呈現下行趨勢，最新財報失利則進一步加重賣壓。Alphabet 週四 (29 日) 暴跌逾 12%，創史上最大單日跌幅，市值蒸發5,000億美元，自 10 月初以來已下蝶超 16%。
根據 FactSet 數據，Alphabet 的 50 日簡單移動平均線週四降至 340.26 美元，跌破位於 340.93 美元的 200 日均線，形成俗稱的「死亡交叉」。此前，截至週三，其 50 日均線已連續 319 個交易日維持在 200 日均線之上。
死亡交叉代表近期平均股價跌至較長期間的平均水準之下，反映短期走勢已明顯弱於過去大部分時間的表現，通常被視為長期趨勢轉弱的訊號。
但這項訊號並不等同股價接下來必然續跌。
由於移動平均線是依據歷史收盤價計算，具有落後性，交叉出現時，股價往往已經歷一段跌勢。它較能確認跌勢持續的時間與幅度，未必能精準判斷進出場時點。
Alphabet 過往的表現也顯示，死亡交叉與後續走勢之間，並沒有單一答案。
根據道瓊市場數據，該股過去十年曾出現五次死亡交叉，其中四次在六個月後走高，五次的六個月平均漲幅為 21.9%。
最近一次發生於 2025 年 4 月 8 日。當時 Alphabet 在短短兩個月內，已自先前的歷史收盤高點下跌 29.9%，死亡交叉出現當天，恰好也是那波賣壓觸底之日。
然而，2022 年的經驗則呈現不同結果。當年 3 月 9 日出現死亡交叉時，Alphabet 股價已較四個月前的歷史高點下跌 11%，之後卻再跌 37.5%，直到同年 11 月 3 日、約八個月後才落底。這也說明，即使交叉形成前已有明顯跌幅，後續仍可能存在相當大的下行空間。
除了均線變化，Alphabet 的相對強弱指標 (RSI) 也顯示賣壓已相當集中。
其 14 日 RSI 降至 23.1，為 2011 年 6 月以來最低水準。
RSI 用於衡量價格變動的速度與幅度，交易員通常將 30 以下視為進入超賣區，反映股票短期內承受強烈賣壓。
Alphabet 目前的讀值遠低於這道門檻，意味近期跌勢已相當急促，也使市場開始關注是否可能出現反彈。
不過，超賣本身並不能確認股價已經落底。Alphabet 目前同時面臨財報失利、搜尋業務成長放緩與 AI 策略疑慮；歷史上的反彈紀錄與偏低的 RSI，提供的是賣壓可能接近極端的線索，能否轉化為持續回升，仍有待後續走勢驗證。
paras_en: Google parent company Alphabet (GOOGL-US) posted a third‑quarter earnings report that fell short of expectations, with its core search business slowing, sending the stock tumbling over 12% on Thursday (the 29th) and triggering a bearish technical "death cross". However, historical data shows that in most cases over the past decade, after this signal appears, the stock actually climbs higher six months later; another momentum indicator has also dropped to a more than 15‑year low, leaving room for speculation that the decline may be nearing its end.

MarketWatch reported that investors have been questioning Alphabet’s artificial intelligence (AI) strategy for months, and the stock has already been on a downtrend, with the latest earnings miss further intensifying selling pressure. Alphabet slumped more than 12% on Thursday (the 29th), marking its biggest single‑day drop in history, wiping out $500 billion in market value and falling more than 16% since early October.

According to FactSet data, Alphabet’s 50‑day simple moving average fell to $340.26 on Thursday, slipping below the 200‑day moving average at $340.93 and creating the so‑called "death cross." Prior to that, as of Wednesday, its 50‑day average had stayed above the 200‑day line for 319 consecutive trading days.

A death cross means the short‑term average price has fallen below the longer‑term average, indicating that recent momentum is clearly weaker than most of the past, and it is usually taken as a signal of a weakening long‑term trend.
But this signal does not mean the stock must continue to fall.

Because moving averages are calculated from historical closing prices, they are lagging; when a cross occurs, the price has often already undergone a decline. The cross is better at confirming how long and how far a downtrend may last, not at pinpointing precise entry or exit points.
Alphabet’s past performance also shows that there is no single answer linking a death cross to subsequent price action.

Based on Dow Jones market data, the stock has experienced five death crosses in the past ten years, and in four of those cases the price rose again after six months, with an average six‑month gain of 21.9% across the five instances.

The most recent occurrence was on April 8, 2025. At that time Alphabet had already fallen 29.9% from a prior historical closing high within just two months, and the day the death cross appeared coincided with the bottom of that selling pressure.

However, the 2022 experience yielded a different outcome. When a death cross formed on March 9, 2022, the stock was already 11% below its historical high from four months earlier, and it fell another 37.5% afterward, not bottoming out until November 3 of the same year, about eight months later. This shows that even after a sizable prior decline, substantial downside can still follow.
In addition to the moving‑average shift, Alphabet’s relative strength index (RSI) also indicates that selling pressure has become heavily concentrated.
Its 14‑day RSI dropped to 23.1, the lowest level since June 2011.
The RSI measures the speed and magnitude of price changes, and traders typically view readings below 30 as entering oversold territory, reflecting strong short‑term selling pressure.
Alphabet’s current reading is well below that threshold, suggesting the recent decline has been quite rapid and prompting the market to wonder whether a rebound may be imminent.

However, oversold conditions alone do not confirm that the stock has bottomed. Alphabet is simultaneously dealing with a disappointing earnings report, slowing search‑business growth and AI‑strategy concerns; historical rebound patterns and a low RSI merely hint that selling pressure may be reaching an extreme, and whether that will translate into a sustained recovery remains to be seen.

items.title: 日銀利率暫留1.25% 分析師估12月升至1.5% 終點上看2%
items.title_en: BOJ Keeps Rate at 1.25% – Analysts See 1.5% Rise in December, Target Around 2%
paras: 日本銀行 (日銀) 預計在周五 (30日) 結束的貨幣政策會議上維持基準利率於1.25%不變，但可能在最新季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的通膨預測，並強調日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。這將顯示日銀政策重心正從長期刺激通膨，轉向防止物價漲幅超標，為最快12月再次升息保留空間。
《路透社》報導指出，日銀此次預計不會連續兩次會議升息，而是希望進一步觀察先前升息對銀行放款條件與金融環境的影響。不過，日銀可能藉由政策聲明釋出更明確的訊號，表明未來將持續調升利率，逐步使利率接近不刺激、也不抑制經濟活動的中性水準。

這項政策轉向將延續日銀上月傳達的訊息。分析人士指出，日銀已進入較為重視抑制通膨風險的政策階段，未來可能每隔數個月升息一次。瑞穗研究所 (Mizuho Research Institute) 執行經濟學家、日銀前高層門間一夫表示，人工智慧 (AI) 投資帶來的全球價格壓力相當強勁，近期通膨有一部分是由需求增加所推動。他認為，日銀若確認政策方向已經轉變，等於向市場傳達可能每季升息的訊號，並預測日銀可能在12月及明年3月升息。
日銀總裁植田和男會後記者會的談話，也將成為市場觀察未來升息時點與幅度的重要依據。熟悉日銀想法的人士向《路透社》透露，日銀可能在季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的物價預測，並指出日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。隨著薪資成長逐漸穩定，企業與家庭的通膨預期也維持在約2%，日銀可能強調，接下來的政策任務是透過逐步升息，讓通膨穩定在目標附近。
日本通膨壓力仍是日銀考慮進一步緊縮政策的主要原因。9月核心消費者物價通膨率在睽違9個月後再次超過日銀2%的目標，中東衝突延長推升燃料成本，也削弱政府燃料補貼對物價的抑制效果。日銀7月公布的季度預測原本就預期，隨著企業持續將成本上升轉嫁給消費者，未來數月通膨可能加速。
日元走弱同樣加劇物價壓力。日元貶值推高進口商品成本，能源價格居高不下則進一步增加企業與家庭負擔。日銀今年6月升息後，9月再度調高利率，兩次升息間隔已短於2024年與2025年大約每年升息兩次的節奏，顯示政策正常化速度正在加快。
根據《路透社》對分析師的調查，多數受訪者預期日銀最快在12月將政策利率由1.25%提高至1.5%，之後明年仍會繼續升息。分析師對本輪升息周期終點利率的預估，主要落在1.75%至2%之間。若日銀明確表示基礎通膨已達到與2%目標一致的水準，市場可能將此解讀為央行不願容忍通膨進一步超標，未來升息步伐也可能更加靈活。
不過，日銀仍須在控制物價與維持經濟穩定之間取得平衡。若過早或過快升息，可能對企業融資、銀行放款及整體經濟活動造成影響；若通膨壓力持續擴大，則可能迫使央行加快緊縮步伐。因此，即使此次會議預計按兵不動，市場仍將密切觀察日銀是否調整通膨預測，以及植田和男對未來政策路徑的說明。
日銀政策轉向也與全球通膨環境相互呼應。AI產業投資熱潮推升部分商品與服務需求，中東衝突則造成能源供應與價格風險，美國與歐洲央行同樣面臨通膨壓力升高的挑戰。對日本而言，能源成本上升、日元偏弱與薪資成長逐步擴散，正共同影響物價走勢。
整體而言，日銀此次會議的關鍵不只在於是否維持1.25%的利率，更在於能否清楚傳達下一階段的政策方向。若日銀確認基礎通膨已接近目標，並上修未來物價預測，將進一步強化市場對12月升息的預期；但實際升息時間與後續幅度，仍取決於通膨、薪資、匯率及金融環境的變化。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1.25% at the monetary‑policy meeting ending on Friday (the 30th), but may slightly raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the latest quarterly outlook and stress that core inflation has basically reached the 2% target. This would show the BOJ’s focus shifting from long‑term stimulus to preventing price gains from overshooting, leaving room for a possible rate hike as early as December.

Reuters reported that the BOJ does not plan to raise rates at two consecutive meetings, preferring to watch how the previous hike affects banks’ lending conditions and the broader financial environment. However, the central bank may use its policy statement to send a clearer signal that it will keep tightening, gradually moving rates toward a neutral level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic activity.

This policy shift continues the message the BOJ delivered last month. Analysts say the bank has entered a phase that places greater emphasis on curbing inflation risks and may raise rates every few months. Mizuho Research Institute senior economist and former BOJ official Kazuo Kadokawa noted that AI‑driven investment is creating strong global price pressure and that recent inflation is partly demand‑driven. He believes that once the BOJ confirms the policy turn, it will signal to the market a possible quarterly hike and forecasts rate increases in December and March next year.

Comments by BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting will be a key reference for the market on the timing and magnitude of future hikes. Sources familiar with the BOJ told Reuters that the bank may modestly lift its price outlook for the next fiscal year in the quarterly outlook and point out that core inflation has essentially hit the 2% goal. With wage growth stabilising, firms and households expect inflation around 2%, and the BOJ may stress that its next task is to bring inflation close to target through gradual rate hikes.

Inflation pressure in Japan remains the main reason the BOJ is considering further tightening. Core CPI in September again exceeded the 2% target for the first time in nine months, while the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed fuel costs higher and weakened the effect of government fuel subsidies. The BOJ’s July quarterly forecast already anticipated that, as firms keep passing higher costs onto consumers, inflation could accelerate in the coming months.

A weaker yen also amplifies price pressure. Yen depreciation raises the cost of imported goods, and persistently high energy prices further increase the burden on firms and households. After the BOJ’s June hike, it raised rates again in September, with the interval between hikes now shorter than the roughly semi‑annual rhythm expected for 2024‑25, indicating an accelerating pace of policy normalisation.

A Reuters poll of analysts found most expect the BOJ to lift the policy rate from 1.25% to 1.5% as early as December, with further hikes likely next year. Analysts’ forecasts for the end‑point of this tightening cycle cluster around 1.75%‑2%. If the BOJ explicitly states that core inflation has reached the 2% target, markets may read that as a sign the central bank will not tolerate further overshoot, making future hikes potentially more flexible.

Nevertheless, the BOJ must balance price control with economic stability. Raising rates too early or too quickly could hurt corporate financing, bank lending and overall activity, while persistent inflation pressure could force a faster tightening. Hence, even if the meeting ends with a hold, markets will watch closely for any revision to inflation forecasts and Governor Ueda’s guidance on the policy path ahead.

The BOJ’s policy turn also mirrors the global inflation environment. AI‑driven investment is boosting demand for certain goods and services, the Middle‑East conflict is creating energy‑supply and price risks, and central banks in the US and Europe face similar inflation‑driving challenges. For Japan, rising energy costs, a soft yen and gradually expanding wages are jointly shaping price dynamics.

Overall, the key to this BOJ meeting is not only whether the 1.25% rate is maintained but also whether the bank can clearly convey its next‑stage policy direction. If the BOJ confirms core inflation is near target and upgrades its price outlook, it will reinforce market expectations of a December hike; however, the actual timing and size of any future moves will still depend on developments in inflation, wages, exchange rates and the financial environment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走貶 Fed、ECB維持利率不變
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Weakens as Fed and ECB Hold Rates Steady
paras: 美元周四(29日)小幅走貶，外匯市場參與者消化聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)的利率決策，歐元則微幅上漲。兩家央行均一如市場普遍預期，決定維持利率不變。另一方面，英國公布由Andy Burnham領導下的首份預算案後，英鎊連續第二個交易日延續漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.02。
聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）週三以10票對2票決定維持主要政策利率不變。聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克克(Beth Hammack)則主張升息1碼。這項結果大致符合市場預期，聯準會先前已於9月進行三年多來首次升息。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策公布後表示，近期經濟展現強勁動能，央行也持續致力於實現2%的年度通膨目標，但他拒絕對未來利率走向提供任何前瞻指引。市場目前普遍預期，聯準會將在12月今年最後一次會議上升息。
華許表示，「自我們9月採取政策行動以來，金融與信貸環境已開始出現一些變化。正如我們預期，部分企業與家庭面臨的金融與信貸條件已經收緊。市場參與者在資本配置方面也變得更加審慎。」
他接著表示，「儘管整體金融環境已經收緊，但我不願、也無法將其稱為緊縮。不過，整體而言，這些發展有助於實現更長久、更持續的經濟成長與物價穩定。」
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams指出，華許這段談話的後半部分，是記者會上最關鍵的一段發言。
Adams表示，「這段話有三個含意。第一，聯準會認為有理由進一步升息，因為『朝著這個方向前進』意味著目標尚未達成。第二，聯準會希望透過適度升息進行經濟週期中段的調整，而不是將利率推升至足以引發嚴重經濟放緩的緊縮水準。第三，即使華許希望自己能放棄前瞻指引，聯準會仍在運用這項政策工具。」
華許也指出，直到12月會議前，還有大量經濟數據將陸續公布，聯準會可以先評估這些數據，再決定是否進一步調整政策。
這波數據發布潮週四正式展開，投資人迎來美國第三季國內生產毛額（GDP）與9月重要通膨數據。
美國經濟分析局的初步估計顯示，美國第三季實質GDP成長3.4%，高於第二季的2.2%，也超越經濟學家預期的3.2%。
另一方面，被廣泛視為聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數——9月整體月增0.5%，核心PCE則月增0.3%。
以年增率計算，整體PCE上升3.6%，核心PCE則微升至3.1%。四項數據均符合市場預期，但年增率數據顯示通膨較8月加速，且明顯高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
ECB維持利率不變 歐元微幅上漲
歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1162美元。
歐洲央行稍早宣布維持三項主要政策利率不變，與聯準會的決策一致。這項決定廣受市場預期。與聯準會相同，市場目前也預期歐洲央行將在12月升息。
央行在聲明中指出，能源價格「持續上漲，對通膨前景構成上行風險，並對經濟成長前景構成下行風險」。
歐洲央行官員也表示，能源衝擊的全部影響仍在逐步顯現，而基礎物價漲幅「迄今大致保持穩定」。此外，官員指出，自上次會議以來，融資環境已經收緊。
央行另宣布，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)將於明年卸任，提前結束原定為期8年的任期。她目前領導這家央行的時間已略超過7年。
德意志銀行經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「預測歐洲央行的貨幣政策走向正變得更加困難。一個問題是，先前已經實施的兩次升息，加上9月以來金融環境的收緊，是否足以抑制能源通膨風險進一步升高？答案可能是否定的。」
他接著表示，「另一個問題是，歐洲央行領導層的變動是否會影響明年的決策？我們認為，這個機構的重要性高於個別領導者，但其中仍存在不確定性。我們預期央行將在12月再升息一次，將利率提高至2.75%，屆時拉加德仍將擔任總裁，而這可能就是本輪升息週期的終點。」
英國預算案獲市場青睞 英鎊延續漲勢
英鎊兌美元上漲0.3%，至1.3361美元，連續第二個交易日走高。
英國財政大臣John Healey週三公布預算案，維持財政規則，並避免出現沒有資金來源支撐的額外借款衝擊。預算案也確認，英國財政部在2029／30財政年度保留150億英鎊（約200.5億美元）的財政空間，符合主要交易商的預期。
德銀首席英國經濟學家Sanjay Raja週三表示，「財政大臣在秋季預算案公布前的核心原則是『不要造成傷害』，我們認為他成功達成了這個目標。最大幅度的支出增加來自表外投資。此外，降低生活成本與企業營運成本的措施，也占據了預算案相當重要的部分。」
他補充，「目前，財政大臣為自己爭取到了更多時間，但英國的財政處境正變得愈來愈微妙，更艱難的抉擇仍在後頭。」

paras_en: The dollar slipped slightly on Thursday (the 29th) as forex market participants digested the Federal Reserve’s and European Central Bank’s rate decisions, while the euro edged up modestly. Both central banks, as widely expected, left rates unchanged. Meanwhile, after the UK unveiled its first budget under Andy Burnham, the pound continued its rally for a second consecutive trading day.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.2% to 102.02.

The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10‑2 on Wednesday to keep the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The outcome was broadly in line with market expectations, following the Fed’s first rate increase in over three years back in September.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the decision that the economy has shown strong momentum recently and the central bank remains committed to achieving its 2% annual inflation goal, but he declined to provide any forward guidance on future rate moves. Markets currently expect the Fed to raise rates at its final meeting in December.

Warsh added, “Since we took policy action in September, the financial and credit environment has begun to show some changes. As we anticipated, financial and credit conditions for some businesses and households have tightened. Market participants have also become more cautious in capital allocation.”

He continued, “Although the overall financial environment has tightened, I am reluctant to label it as ‘tightening.’ Nonetheless, overall these developments help pave the way for more durable, sustained economic growth and price stability.”
Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, noted that the latter part of Warsh’s remarks was the most critical segment of the press conference.

Adams explained, “That statement carries three implications. First, the Fed sees reason to hike further because ‘moving in that direction’ signals the target has not yet been met. Second, the Fed wants to make a moderate mid‑cycle adjustment rather than push rates to a level that would trigger a severe economic slowdown. Third, even though Warsh says he would like to abandon forward guidance, the Fed is still using that tool.”
Warsh also pointed out that a large amount of economic data will be released before the December meeting, allowing the Fed to assess the numbers before deciding on any further policy adjustments.
The data‑release wave kicked off on Thursday, with investors awaiting U.S. third‑quarter GDP and key September inflation figures.
Preliminary estimates from the Bureau of Economic Analysis show real GDP grew 3.4% in Q3, up from 2.2% in Q2 and ahead of economists’ 3.2% forecast.
Meanwhile, the inflation gauge most favored by the Fed – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, with core PCE up 0.3%.

On an annual basis, overall PCE increased 3.6% and core PCE edged up to 3.1%. All four numbers matched market expectations, but the annual rates show inflation picking up from August and remaining well above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target.
ECB Holds Rates Steady, Euro Edges Higher
The euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1162.

The European Central Bank earlier announced it would keep its three main policy rates unchanged, mirroring the Fed’s decision. The move was widely anticipated. Like the Fed, markets now expect the ECB to raise rates in December.
In its statement, the ECB noted that energy prices “continue to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.”

ECB officials added that the full impact of the energy shock is still unfolding, while underlying price growth “has so far remained broadly stable.” They also said financing conditions have tightened since the last meeting.
The bank also announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down next year, ending her originally eight‑year term early. She has been at the helm for just over seven years.

Deutsche Bank economist Mark Wall said, “Predicting the ECB’s policy path is becoming increasingly difficult. One question is whether the two prior hikes, combined with the tightening financial environment since September, are enough to curb the risk of rising energy‑driven inflation. The answer may well be no.”

He continued, “Another question is whether the change in ECB leadership will affect next year’s decisions. We believe the institution’s importance outweighs any individual leader, but uncertainty remains. We expect another rate hike in December, taking the rate to 2.75%, with Lagarde still in charge, which could mark the end of this tightening cycle.”
UK Budget Wins Market Favor, Pound Continues Rise
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.3361, marking a second straight trading‑day gain.

UK Chancellor John Healey unveiled the budget on Wednesday, maintaining fiscal rules and avoiding additional borrowing without a funding source. The plan also confirmed that the Treasury will retain £15 billion (about $20.05 billion) of fiscal space for FY 2029/30, in line with major dealer expectations.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said on Wednesday, “The core principle of the autumn budget was ‘do no harm,’ and we think the chancellor achieved that. The biggest spending increase comes from off‑balance‑sheet investment. Measures to lower living costs and business operating costs also feature prominently in the budget.”
He added, “The chancellor has bought himself more time, but the UK’s fiscal situation is becoming increasingly delicate, and tougher choices lie ahead.”
As of about 5:40 a.m. Taiwan time on Friday (the 30th):

The dollar index was at 101.9232, up 0.0368%. The euro was at $1.1174, down 0.0537%. The pound was at $1.3373, down 0.0299%. The Australian dollar was at $0.7030, up 0.0142%. The USD/CAD rate was 1.3990, up 0.0143%. The USD/JPY rate was 157.6400, down 0.0380%.

items.title: 拉加德提前走人！ECB接班兩強浮現 誰來接招通膨與法債風險？
items.title_en: Lagarde Leaves Early! Two Strong Candidates Emerge to Lead the ECB Amid Inflation and French Debt Risks
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)周四(29日)宣布，將於2027年2月7日提前卸任，比原訂同年10月底任期屆滿提早近九個月。此舉讓接班競逐進入關鍵階段，前西班牙央行總裁戴柯斯(Pablo Hernández de Cos)與前荷蘭央行總裁諾特(Klaas Knot)被視為最有力人選。
綜合《CNBC》與《彭博》報導，歐洲理事會主席柯斯塔(António Costa)表示，繼任者遴選程序將立即展開。歐元區21個成員國可能力爭年底前達成共識，並一併協商明年即將出缺的ECB首席經濟學家與執行理事職位。
拉加德在ECB公布最新利率決策前宣布辭職，感謝團隊過去七年的支持，並獲管理委員會起立鼓掌。她任內歷經疫情、俄烏戰爭與能源價格衝擊；如今歐元區9月通膨再攀三年高點，接班人仍須面對物價與金融穩定的雙重考驗。

戴柯斯民調領先 諾特具金融穩定經驗

現年55歲、目前掌舵國際清算銀行(BIS)的戴柯斯，在《彭博》分析師調查中居於領先。他已獲西班牙總理桑傑士支持，可能在11月29日提前大選勝出的中間偏右人民黨，也表態支持他，降低政黨輪替對提名的影響。
戴柯斯過去被視為偏鴿派，但若提前離開BIS，可能引發對該機構聲譽及接班安排的疑慮，成為競逐ECB職位的阻力。
59歲的諾特則於8月獲荷蘭政府正式提名。他曾任金融穩定委員會(FSB)主席，相關經驗被認為有助應對債市動盪。不過，他自2025年中卸任荷蘭央行總裁後已離開決策第一線一段時間，加上荷蘭過去已出過ECB總裁，可能影響各國支持意願。
諾特原被視為鷹派，曾反對前總裁德拉吉的部分寬鬆政策，之後立場逐漸溫和。他本月仍表示，經濟與地緣政治衝擊可能要求ECB未來幾年略偏向緊縮。

法國債務風險升溫 接班角力牽動政策方向

接班安排不僅涉及專業能力，也牽涉國籍、區域與性別平衡。德國央行總裁內格爾(Joachim Nagel)、義大利央行總裁帕內塔(Fabio Panetta)，以及歐洲投資銀行總裁卡爾維尼奧(Nadia Calviño)，也曾被點名；卡爾維尼奧已否認參選意願，但仍有人認為，各國可能尋求另一名女性接任。
新總裁除須讓通膨回到2%，也得處理法國債務壓力與歐元區公債利差擴大的風險。法國明年總統大選更添變數，市場正討論ECB是否可能動用干預工具。
《彭博》經濟研究認為，相較戴柯斯，諾特可能採取較緊的貨幣政策，對干預法國債市也較不積極。Berenberg首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding則指出，諾特的金融穩定經驗可能成為優勢，但ECB無意替法國失衡的財政政策埋單。
至於拉加德下一步，英國《金融時報》(FT)曾報導，她是世界經濟論壇下一任主席的熱門人選；她近期則暗示，無意角逐2027年法國總統。
paras_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde announced on Thursday the 29th that she will step down early on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term was set to end in late October 2027. Her early departure pushes the succession race into a critical phase, with former Spanish central bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos and former Dutch central bank governor Klaas Knot seen as the strongest contenders.

According to reports from CNBC and Bloomberg, European Council President António Costa said the selection process for her successor will start immediately. The 21 euro‑area member states are expected to strive for a consensus by the end of the year and will also negotiate the appointments for the ECB’s chief economist and an executive board seat that will become vacant next year.

Lagarde resigned just before the ECB announced its latest rate decision, thanking her team for seven years of support and receiving a standing ovation from the management board. Her tenure spanned the pandemic, the Russia‑Ukraine war and energy price shocks; now euro‑area inflation in September has climbed to a three‑year high, and her successor will still have to face the dual challenge of price stability and financial stability.

At 55, de Cos, who now heads the Bank for International Settlements, leads a Bloomberg analyst poll. He has the backing of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and the centre‑right People’s Party, which is expected to win an early election on November 29, further reducing the impact of a change of government on his nomination.

De Cos has previously been viewed as dovish, but an early departure from the BIS could raise concerns about the institution’s reputation and succession plan, potentially becoming a hurdle in the race for the ECB chairmanship.

The 59‑year‑old Knot was formally nominated by the Dutch government in August. He previously chaired the Financial Stability Board, experience seen as useful for dealing with bond‑market turbulence. However, he left the front line of decision‑making after stepping down as Dutch central bank governor in mid‑2025, and the fact that the Netherlands has already produced an ECB president may affect the level of support from other countries.

Knot was originally seen as a hawk, having opposed some of former President Draghi’s easing measures, but his stance has gradually softened. He said this month that economic and geopolitical shocks could require the ECB to tilt slightly more towards tightening over the next few years.

The succession not only involves professional competence but also considerations of nationality, regional balance and gender. Germany’s central bank president Joachim Nagel, Italy’s central bank governor Fabio Panetta and European Investment Bank president Nadia Calviño have also been mentioned; Calviño has denied any interest in running, yet some argue that countries may still look for another woman to take the role.

The new president will have to bring inflation back to 2% while also dealing with French debt pressures and the risk of widening sovereign‑bond spreads across the euro area. France’s presidential election next year adds further uncertainty, and markets are debating whether the ECB might resort to intervention tools.

Bloomberg’s economic research suggests that, compared with de Cos, Knot may pursue a tighter monetary stance and be less inclined to intervene in the French bond market. Berenberg chief economist Holger Schmieding notes that Knot’s financial‑stability background could be an advantage, but the ECB has no intention of footing the bill for France’s imbalanced fiscal policy.

As for Lagarde’s next move, the Financial Times reported that she is a leading candidate to become the next chair of the World Economic Forum; she has recently hinted that she has no intention of running for the French presidency in 2027.

items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Actively Supports Market as Rupiah Rebounds After Six Days of Decline
paras: 印尼盾(IDR)在經歷連續6個交易日下跌後，周四(29日)強勁反彈，以擺脫在歷史低點附近徘徊。
美元兌印尼盾匯率自 10 月 27 日創下的近5個月高點 18,223 回落，盤中一度走軟至 18,185，隨後回升至 18,108 至 18,127 區間，跌幅達 0.4%，有望創下自 9 月 30 日以來的最大單日跌幅。
FXStreet 分析師 Akhtar Faruqui 指出，印尼盾走強主要受到印尼中央銀行積極護盤的支撐。印尼央行重申，將持續透過無本金交割遠期外匯(NDF)、國內無本金交割遠期外匯(DNDF)、現貨市場干預，以及在次級市場購入國債等多重工具以穩定匯市。
外部環境方面，美國聯準會決議將基準利率維持在 3.75%–4.00% 不變。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)發表談話時重申，公開市場委員會(FOMC)將堅守物價穩定與 2% 的通膨目標，並強調底層經濟成長依然強勁。
不過此項利率決策並未獲得全體一致同意，聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭Fed主席哈馬克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張應立即升息1碼(25 個基點)以應對居高不下的物價壓力。華許更為溫和的表態被市場解讀為偏向鴿派，進一步推升了亞洲主要貨幣。
儘管央行出手干預，印尼當地金融市場仍承受顯著壓力。印尼 10 年期公債殖利率一度攀升至7.7%–7.707% 的近年新高，顯著高於 2026 財年預算設定的 6.9% 基準，隨後微幅下降 3 個基點至 7.62%。
由於市場對財政風險及通膨隱憂未除，加上印尼在 MSCI 指數中面臨可能被降級為獨立市場狀態的不確定性，導致外資持續賣超並引發資本外流疑慮。雅加達綜合指數仍下挫 2% 至 5,175.15 點。
交易員目前正密切關注即將公布的 9 月貿易數據與 10 月通膨報告，以評估後續經濟與匯率走勢。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah (IDR) staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 29th) after six consecutive trading days of decline, shaking off its slide near historic lows.

The USD/IDR rate fell from the near‑five‑month high of 18,223 set on October 27, slipping intraday to as low as 18,185 before climbing back into the 18,108‑18,127 range, a drop of about 0.4% that could mark the biggest single‑day decline since September 30.

FXStreet analyst Akhtar Faruqui said the rupiah’s strength is mainly backed by the Bank Indonesia’s active market‑support measures. The central bank reiterated it will continue to use a mix of non‑deliverable forwards (NDF), domestic NDFs (DNDF), spot market interventions and purchases of government bonds in the secondary market to stabilise the exchange rate.

On the external front, the U.S. Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, in his remarks, reaffirmed that the Federal Open Market Committee will stay committed to price stability and a 2% inflation target, stressing that underlying economic growth remains robust.

However, the rate decision was not unanimous; Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted against it, arguing for an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to curb persistent inflation pressures. Warsh’s more dovish tone was read by markets as a tilt toward easing, further lifting major Asian currencies.

Despite the central bank’s intervention, Indonesia’s domestic financial markets remain under significant strain. The 10‑year government bond yield briefly spiked to a recent high of 7.7%‑7.707%, well above the 6.9% benchmark set in the FY2026 budget, before easing by three basis points to 7.62%.

Because fiscal‑risk and inflation concerns persist, and Indonesia faces the possibility of being reclassified as a frontier market in MSCI indices, foreign investors continue to sell, raising worries about capital outflows. The Jakarta Composite Index fell another 2% to 5,175.15 points.
Traders are now closely watching the upcoming September trade data and October inflation report to gauge the next moves in the economy and the rupiah.

items.title: 歐洲央行料將維持利率不變 以評估法國動盪及能源風險
items.title_en: ECB Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged to Assess French Turmoil and Energy Risks
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(29日)預計將基準存款利率維持在 2.50% 不變，暫緩升息步伐。儘管中東伊朗衝突引發原油價格震盪與通膨隱憂，但在歐元區經濟動態放緩與法國國債市場劇烈波動的雙重夾擊下，決策者普遍選擇維持政策現狀，並將目光投向 12 月的政策展望。
歐元區當前通膨率接近 4%，遠高於 2% 的政策目標，但升幅主要集中於能源領域。彭博經濟研究(Bloomberg Economics)分析師David Powell與Simona Delle Chiaie指出：「歐洲央行幾乎肯定會在本次會議暫停升息；借貸成本上升已收緊金融條件，面對主權債券市場動盪，決策者希望避免火上澆油。」
德國貝倫貝格銀行首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding表示：「歐洲央行可能會表明，近期油價再度飆升，使通膨上行風險比 9 月時更為顯著。」
歐洲央行管理委員會委員Pierre Wunsch指出，市場預估央行未來將採取更多行動「是合理的基準情境，但全球仍處於極具不確定性的環境中」。貨幣市場目前定價年底前仍可能重啟升息，預估存款利率最終可能推升至 3.25%。
除了貨幣政策路線，法國公債市場的動盪成為即時挑戰。受預算赤字膨脹、政治分歧與社會動盪影響，法國 10 年期國債殖利率升破 5%，創下 24 年新高，與德國基準公債的利差亦擴大至 15 年新高。
針對央行是否干預，法國安盛集團(AXA Group)首席經濟學家Gilles Moec認為：「保留歐洲央行干預市場的可能性至關重要。」
但是，Lombard Odier歐洲、中東及非洲地區投資長Nannette Hechler-Fayd'Herbe強調：「干預門檻相當高，除非真的面臨擴散風險、金融市場運作失序或全歐流動性緊縮，否則不預計歐央行會動用傳播保護工具(TPI)。」
Algebris 基金管理公司經濟學家團隊分析，目前法國風險仍侷限於國內，若發生溢出效應，央行可能考慮對其他成員國啟用 TPI，但對法國保持立場。
市場同時高度關注歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)的去留問題，傳聞指出拉加德可能提前接任世界經濟論壇(WEF)主席。日本三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深經濟學家Henry Cook警告：「在央行面臨金融條件收緊、能源價格上漲及總體經濟前景不確定性升級之際，領導層出現任何不確定性都絕非理想狀況。」
目前荷蘭前央行總裁 Klaas Knot 與西班牙前央行總裁 Pablo Hernandez de Cos 被視為接任歐洲央行總裁的熱門人選。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 29th) is expected to keep its key deposit rate at 2.50%, pausing its rate‑hiking cycle. Despite oil price swings and inflation concerns sparked by the Middle‑East conflict involving Iran, policymakers are broadly opting to maintain the status quo amid slowing euro‑area economic activity and sharp volatility in the French sovereign bond market, turning their attention to the policy outlook for December.

Euro‑area inflation is currently close to 4%, well above the 2% target, but the rise is largely confined to energy. Bloomberg Economics analysts David Powell and Simona Delle Chiaie note, “The ECB is almost certain to pause rate hikes at this meeting; higher borrowing costs have already tightened financial conditions, and facing sovereign‑bond market turbulence, policymakers want to avoid adding fuel to the fire.”
Germany’s Berenberg Bank chief economist Holger Schmieding said, “The ECB may point out that the recent surge in oil prices makes inflation‑upside risks more pronounced than they were in September.”

ECB Governing Council member Pierre Wunsch said that market expectations of further ECB action “are a reasonable baseline scenario, but the world remains highly uncertain.” Money markets are still pricing in the possibility of a rate hike before year‑end, with the deposit rate potentially climbing to 3.25% eventually.

Beyond monetary policy, turbulence in the French sovereign‑bond market is an immediate challenge. Driven by a widening budget deficit, political divisions and social unrest, the yield on France’s 10‑year bond has broken above 5%, a 24‑year high, while the spread over German benchmark bonds has widened to a 15‑year peak.
Regarding possible ECB intervention, AXA Group chief economist Gilles Moec said, “Keeping the option of ECB market intervention open is crucial.”

However, Lombard Odier’s head of investment for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Nannette Hechler‑Fayd’Herbe, stressed, “The intervention threshold is quite high; unless there is a genuine spill‑over risk, a breakdown in market functioning, or a Europe‑wide liquidity squeeze, the ECB is not expected to deploy its Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI).”

Algebris fund‑management economists argue that French risk remains largely domestic; if spill‑over effects emerge, the ECB might consider using TPI for other member states, but would maintain its stance on France.

Markets are also closely watching the fate of ECB President Christine Lagarde, with rumours that she could take over the World Economic Forum (WEF) chairmanship ahead of schedule. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group senior economist Henry Cook warned, “When the central bank faces tighter financial conditions, rising energy prices and escalating macro‑economic uncertainty, any uncertainty about its leadership is far from ideal.”
Former Dutch central‑bank governor Klaas Knot and former Spanish central‑bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos are currently seen as the leading candidates to succeed Lagarde as ECB president.

隨著也門戰事持續，外界擔憂中東能源進一步受擾提升油價，美元仍保持避險貨幣地位，而且儘管日本政府一再否認，但其整體立場偏向再通貨膨脹，可能設法推遲BOJ升息，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓升至158.34高點。隨後美國公布9月商品貿易逆差意外擴大至1,349億美元，並據FED以10票贊成、理事庫克和克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克主張加息25個基點，如預期維持聯邦基金利率區間在3.75%-4.00%，而且FED主席沃什在新聞會表示，經濟成長強勁的和通貨膨脹高企，未來仍可能再收緊貨幣政策，芝加哥商品交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具則顯示FED在12月加息的機率85%，但本次會議結果已在廣泛預期中，引發美元兌日圓回落。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)較前季升1.3%及較上年同期漲3.9%，澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克則警告物價壓力仍居高不下，政策制定者將於下周討論今年四次升息是否足以實現通貨膨脹目標，提升RBA下週二加息25個基點的機率至88%，但紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管稱未來或仍需收緊政策，引發紐元暴跌，並據德國報告稱，受中國需求轉弱拖累出口，今年德國對亞太地區二十九個經濟體的出口料下降3.2%至1,853億歐元，對亞太貿易逆差料創紀錄高位，推低歐元兌美元至1.1131低點。
據紐倫堡市場決策研究所(NIM)與市場研究機構GfK調查，德國11月消費者信心指數下滑至負30.8，但歐洲央行(ECB)週四的政策會議預計維持利率不變，市場關注ECB對能源價格推動的第二輪通貨膨脹效應提供任何暗示，而且FED決議後美元走弱，歐元兌美元反彈至1.1169高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1140-60，支撐於1.1060-80。
◆GBP/USD

週三英國財政大臣希利料公布審慎的預算計畫，試圖避免讓首相伯納姆的新政府面臨更大的債券市場壓力，市場關注政府如何增加財政收入以支持經濟增長，但英國財政狀況可能比許多歐洲國家緊張，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3269低點，隨著英國財政大臣約翰希利公布首相伯納姆政府的首份財政預算，承諾堅持政府的財政規則，同時向英國家庭發放小額直接補貼及降低食品雜貨關稅，以緩解能源價格上漲衝擊，市場反應正向，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3338高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3315-35，支撐於1.3230-50。

Higher Japanese government‑bond yields and end‑of‑month fund inflows pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 157.63 on Wednesday.

As the war in Yemen drags on, concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and push oil prices higher keep the dollar in safe‑haven mode. Fed Chair Waller said in a news conference that strong growth and high inflation could lead to further monetary tightening. The CME FedWatch tool shows an 85 % probability of a December rate hike. The meeting outcome was widely anticipated, prompting the dollar‑yen to retreat. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 157.50‑70 and face resistance near 158.30‑50 today.

In contrast, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, though it said further tightening may be needed, sending the kiwi tumbling. paras: 美元周三(28日)兌主要貨幣走跌，聯準會(Fed)公布符合市場預期的利率決策。另一方面，紐西蘭央行意外決定維持利率不變，導致紐西蘭幣大幅下跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.15。
聯準會一如預期維持利率不變，選擇等到下週美國期中選舉結束後，再決定是否調整借貸成本，同時等待更多通膨走勢的相關數據。

歐元兌美元上漲0.32%，至1.1160美元。
美元兌日元下跌0.04%，至157.87日元。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，「由於殖利率曲線趨陡，美元比聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前更為疲軟。」

英國財政大臣John Healey週三向國會表示，政府將提高銀行、博弈業者、儲蓄者及房東的稅負，同時收緊亞馬遜等線上市場平台的加值型營業稅規定，以籌措英國預算方案所需資金。

items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.
